allIdeas.title: Lead the Ducklings
allIdeas.rides: RISING: movement-verb 'X For Eggs' hybrid (new verb: LEAD/escort a live trail) on the Steal-a egg economy. Source id: PR-051 (Imprint the Ducklings). Format numbers (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026): Jump To Steal An Egg set its 79,949 ATH in the last 7 days; Race for Eggs set a new ATH of 19,682 in late Sep; +1 Wings For Eggs visits went 5.5M to 15.8M in Sep.
allIdeas.pet_core: The ducklings are both the loot and the movement. They follow you in a visible conga line and stay yours only while they can see you. The ones you get home grow into pond ducks that pay idle income. Route mutations: a mud puddle makes a Mud Duck, the lava biome an Ember Duck.
allIdeas.loop: Every 60s a nest in the shared marsh cracks, and its ducklings imprint on the first player in their sight cone, so players jostle for the spot. You lead your line home across roads, streams and rival yards. A rival who breaks your line's sight for 3s by stepping between re-imprints every duckling behind that point. Ducks in your pond pay coins/sec, which buy bigger nests (more ducklings per hatch), Quack upgrades (longer sight leash) and pond slots. Rebirth opens the weekly marsh biome, with a Haunted Marsh event in late Oct.
allIdeas.twist: Ownership is line of sight, not possession. Nobody grabs or carries anything: you steal by walking between an owner and their tail (a snake-style cut). A long line is both your flex and your weak point, so defending means shorter, smarter routes.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn at the marsh as a nest wobbles on a 5s countdown. You stand in front, it cracks, three ducklings blink at you with a heart pop and waddle after you. Within 20s a rival cuts across your path and you watch the last duckling peel off to them.
allIdeas.money: Loud Quack (+3s sight leash for 10 min, 19R), offered the moment a rival cuts your line; Nest Alarm (ping before a rare nest cracks, 25R), offered at the rare-nest broadcast; Duck Whistle gamepass (recall strays within 20 studs once per trip, 99R), offered after the first lost duckling; Pond Fence (protects idle ducks offline, 35R) at logout.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run: the web-search budget was already exhausted (200/200) before any query went out. Reused the saved Sep 30 2026 search for PR-051: no line-of-sight imprinting mechanic found on Roblox. Catch 1 Billion Ducks has 22.8M visits (market scout, Sep 2026), but it is duck-themed with a different mechanic. Steal An Egg and hatch games dominate the lane (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026).

allIdeas.title: Cast For Eggs
allIdeas.rides: RISING: movement-verb egg hybrid (new verb: CAST and REEL a visible line) on the Steal-a base economy. Source id: PE-002 (Cast Into Their Yard), re-aimed at eggs. Numbers (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026): Jump To Steal An Egg 79,949 ATH in the last 7 days; Swing For Eggs 12.2K (rolimons) vs 20.4K (market scout, Sep 27); +1 Wings For Eggs visits 5.5M to 15.8M in Sep.
allIdeas.pet_core: Hatched pets do visible jobs on your dock instead of acting as multipliers. Crabs scuttle over to snip lines cast into your base, pelicans leap to snatch eggs out of the air as they are reeled over your yard, and otters haul landed eggs to the incubator. Rare pets only come from rare eggs you reel out of rival bases.
allIdeas.loop: Stand on your dock and cast (a charge meter sets the distance) at the central egg barge or a rival's nest. Hook an egg and reel it in against a tension bar (too tight and the line snaps) while the line stays visible across the map. The owner or their crab can run over and snip it. A third player can cast across your line to tangle it and take the egg. Landed eggs incubate and hatch into pets that pay coins and take dock jobs. Coins buy longer rods and stronger lines; rebirth opens a new lake biome each week.
allIdeas.twist: Stealing happens at range on a line everyone can see. Every theft becomes a public tug-of-war with a counter (snip) and a third-party steal (tangle), not a sprint into a base and back.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn on a dock facing a floating barge stacked with glowing eggs. Hold to charge and release; the hook arcs 80 studs and clacks onto a gold egg. You reel it in against a wobbling tension bar and it cracks into a pelican on your dock, all in about 25s. Then a rival's line lands next to your nest.
allIdeas.money: Braided Line (can't be snipped for 60s, 19R), offered the moment your line is cut; Long Rod (+50% range, 49R), offered when a rare egg sits just outside your range ring; Crab Guard shift (auto-snip while offline, 29R) at logout; Lucky Lure (rare-egg bias for 10 min, 25R) at the rare-barge broadcast.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run (budget exhausted, 200/200). Saved Sep 30 2026 search for PE-002: 'Steal a Pet' exists (walk-in steal), and no steal game with a cuttable fishing line was found. Steal Fish Eggs peaked at 45.8K; its current count was not found (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). It has a fish-egg theme, and its mechanics were not verified, so check it before building. Fisch and Fish It! are fishing games without base stealing.

allIdeas.title: Rig the Dog Show
allIdeas.rides: RISING: chaotic short-round PvP with one absurd rule-break in a sport. Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 ATH within the last 7 days and had ~75K on the Sep 30 snapshot; That Freekick Challenge is +25.4% in 24h (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source id: PF-018 (Illegal Dog Show).
allIdeas.pet_core: Your dog is the athlete. Its breed sets its 'stay' strength and what distracts it (retrievers break for balls, beagles for sausages), and grooming sets its look score. Every rosette it wins stays on its collar as a permanent showoff and adds to its resale value.
allIdeas.loop: 8 handlers, 4-minute show. Groom for 30s, then do a gait lap steering your dog on a leash with timing. In the 'STAY' phase on the podium you throw squeaky toys, sausages and water at rivals' dogs. The NPC judge's sightline cone sweeps the ring: a throw inside it earns a warning, and two warnings disqualify you. The podium awards rosettes and coins, which buy pup crates and grooming gear. Weekly class themes include a Halloween costume class in late Oct.
allIdeas.twist: Cheating is the sport. Sabotage is legal until the judge's visible cone catches you, so each round is a stealth-and-timing game played around a pet that must sit still, and breeds counter each other's weaknesses.
allIdeas.first_30s: You enter the ring with a fluffy poodle and a 5s 'STAY!' prompt appears. You lob a squeaky toy behind the judge's back, the rival beagle bolts after it, the crowd gasps, and your poodle takes the first rosette.
allIdeas.money: Blinkers (immune to one distraction, 19R), offered right after your dog breaks; Steward Bribe (clears one warning, 25R) at the first warning; Champion Groom Kit (39R) at the podium; Pup Crate (49R) after a 3rd place.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run (budget exhausted). Saved data: VOTE! Pet Show Dress Up has 120M lifetime visits but only ~100-280 CCU now (Rolimons, in result_existing.jsonl). Dog Race has 28.1M visits, but its CCU fell from 17,569 to 553 (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). No sabotage dog show was found (saved search, Sep 30 2026). Existing-title neighbours (Judge the Cat Show, Win the Ugly Dog Contest, Stack the Show Dog) judge or vote; none use sabotage. D is 3 because pet shows are dead on Roblox, so demand has to come from the Illegal Soccer rule-break hook.

allIdeas.title: Kick For Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Two rising formats together. (1) Chaotic short-round soccer with one absurd rule-break: Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 all-time high inside its latest 7-day window and had about 75K on the Sep 30 snapshot (#16). (2) Movement-verb 'X For Eggs' hybrids: Jump To Steal An Egg set its 79,949 all-time high in its latest 7 days, and Race for Eggs set a new 19,682 high in late Sep. Source: momentum sweep and front-page snapshot, 30 Sep 2026.
allIdeas.pet_core: The ball is a live egg, and the pets you hatch become your rule-breaks. Every clean pass warms the egg one rarity tier, shown as a glow (white, green, blue, purple, gold). A tackle cracks it down one tier. A goal hatches it in the net for the scorer, and everyone in the assist chain gets a copy one tier lower. Before each match you slot ONE pet as your ability: a kangaroo gives a double-jump header, a chameleon makes you invisible for 3 seconds while dribbling, an octopus snatches the ball from 5 studs, a tortoise shell-blocks in goal. It is framed as a sport, not pet fighting.
allIdeas.loop: 3-minute 4v4 match, with bots filling empty seats. Pass to warm your egg and tackle to crack theirs. A goal triggers a hatch reveal in the net. Equip one hatched pet as your ability for the next match. Unequipped pets sit on your locker shelf and earn coins, and locker incubators give a daily return. Coins buy egg-ball skins and locker slots. Queue again: every match ends in a reveal.
allIdeas.twist: Rarity is a number the whole team owns, and only passing raises it. A ball-hog makes everyone's hatch worse. The defending team can win the reveal war by cracking the egg down to common even when it cannot stop the goal.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn straight onto a live pitch at kickoff. The egg-ball glows white with a tag that reads '+1 tier per pass'. A bot teammate calls for it. After two passes it turns blue, you shoot, and at about second 25 it hatches a kangaroo in the net with confetti. The next screen says 'Equip it: double-jump headers'.
allIdeas.money: Warm Boots (25R): your passes count double this match; sold at kickoff. Shell Guard (19R): the next tackle can't crack the egg; offered the moment the egg reaches purple or gold. Golden Kickoff (99R): the next match's egg starts at blue for BOTH teams and the buyer is named on the scoreboard (a social purchase). Extra locker incubator slots are a gamepass.

allIdeas.title: Kick the Egg
allIdeas.rides: RISING: chaotic 4v4 soccer with one absurd rule-break (Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 ATH within the last 7 days and had ~75K on the Sep 30 snapshot) crossed with ride-your-pet mounts (Ride A Pet 152.9-195K on Sep 29-30); momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026. Source ids: PF-019 (Fetch Soccer) + PR-020 (Nose the Ball In).
allIdeas.pet_core: Every player rides a pet, and the pet's movement is its illegal move. A flying fox glides over defenders, a mole burrows under them and pops up with the ball, an otter takes the river shortcut, a kangaroo bounces in headers. Your mount stable is your squad and sets your positions.
allIdeas.loop: Pick a mount from your stable and play a 4v4 match of two 3-min halves on a pitch with a river and soft dirt. The match ball is a giant egg of that match's rarity. The winning team's scorers hatch it; everyone on the losing team hatches a small egg. New mounts bring new illegal moves. There is a ranked ladder, and each weekly update adds a mount with a new movement type.
allIdeas.twist: Soccer where the rule-break is your pet. Each mount species has one move that ignores the pitch (glide, burrow, swim), so drafting mounts is the meta, and the ball itself is the egg you are playing for. It is a sport, not a pet fight.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn on a mole at a 4v4 kickoff. The egg-ball drops; you burrow under a defender, erupt beside the goal and score. The egg wobbles in the net under a 'HATCHES FOR THE WINNERS' banner showing its rarity.
allIdeas.money: Mount Rental (try a premium mount for one match, 19R) at mount select; Golden Egg-Ball vote (upgrades the match ball's rarity and pays the whole winning team, 35R) at kickoff; Extra Stable Slot (49R) at stable cap; Team kits (79R).

allIdeas.title: Swap An Egg
allIdeas.rides: RISING (as a hybrid only): Steal-a base raid plus egg hatching, entered with a changed verb rather than a reskin. Steal An Egg is #1 at 1.15-2.03M live and gained +847,150 over 30 days, but one tracker has it -42% WoW since its 14.27M record on Sep 19 (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source id: PF-001 (Cuckoo an Egg).
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pets are cuckoos. An egg you plant in a rival's nest hatches there into a chick that stays loyal to YOU. It eats the rival's feed and sends you a cut of their base income until they spot it and kick it out.
allIdeas.loop: Raid a rival nest, but you can only take an egg by leaving one of yours in its slot. Eggs are unlabelled until they hatch, so you can paint a dud to look rare. Back home you hatch what you swapped for. Meanwhile your planted cuckoo eggs hatch in rival bases and siphon coins to you. Owners candle eggs to spot cuckoos and evict the chicks. Coins upgrade guard hens (which slow swappers) and paint kits.
allIdeas.twist: Every theft is a forced 1-for-1 swap, so no base ever loses a slot and every raid is also a plant. A painted dud is a bluff, and a good egg left behind is a parasite that pays you from inside their base.
allIdeas.first_30s: You walk into a neighbour's nest carrying a plain egg, press E on their shiny egg, and yours drops into the slot as you run. About 10s later their base shows 'Something hatched...', and a cuckoo chick with YOUR name tag pops up there while coins tick into your counter.
allIdeas.money: Paint Kit (disguise 3 eggs as rares, 19R), offered after a raid; Candling Lamp (see through one egg, 25R) at a swap decision; Guard Hen 1h (35R) at logout; Cuckoo Call (see where all your cuckoos live, 29R) when a cuckoo is evicted.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run (budget exhausted). Saved Sep 30 2026 search for PF-001: Steal An Egg and Swing For Eggs are pure take-loops, and no swap-only egg game was found. Watch: Shuffle an Egg (egg gacha mini-game from the xFrozen group, launched about Sep 30, no data; momentum sweep) has a close name but an unverified mechanic. Theme-swap Steal An Egg reskins are failing (Steal A Brainrot Egg 4.2K on 13.6M visits, Steal A Lucky Egg 6.7K), so the swap-and-parasite verb has to be the pitch, not the egg theme. D is capped at 3 because this changes the verb, not the movement.

allIdeas.title: Ransom a Pet
allIdeas.rides: RISING (as a hybrid only): Steal-a base raid, entered with a changed verb. Steal An Egg is #1 at 1.15-2.03M and gained +847,150 over 30 days, but it is plateauing (flat to -42% WoW by tracker; momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source id: PE-022 (Ransom a Pet).
allIdeas.pet_core: The stolen pet acts on its own. Every 30s it howls, leaving a trail home its owner can follow. A thief who feeds and plays with it can flip its loyalty before the timer ends.
allIdeas.loop: Sneak into a plot and nab a pet. It sits in your ransom kennel on a 10-min timer, and its owner gets a note with your price. The owner can pay, counter, or follow the howl trail and raid the kennel. Meanwhile you can win the pet over with treats; if its loyalty flips before the timer ends, you keep it. Pets that are neither paid for nor flipped run free for anyone to grab. Coins buy kennels, locks and treats.
allIdeas.twist: A theft starts a 10-minute three-way race instead of a transfer. The owner can pay, counter or rescue, the thief can bond, and the pet itself leaks its location, so pricing, bluffing and care beat running.
allIdeas.first_30s: You grab a sleepy corgi from a yard and a ransom note pops up with a price slider. You set 200 coins; the owner counters 120. The corgi howls and a paw-print trail lights up toward you. Now you decide: accept, or feed it treats and hope.
allIdeas.money: Muzzle Treat (silences howling for 2 min, 19R), offered on the first howl; Treasure Map (shows every kennel holding your pets, 25R) when a note arrives; Steel Kennel (35R) when a raid starts; Loyalty Bone (big bond boost, 29R) at 2 min left.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run (budget exhausted). Saved Sep 30 2026 search for PE-022: 'Steal a Pet' exists (steal = keep), and no ransom or counter-offer mechanic was found. Policy risk: kidnapping and ransom framing may be sensitive for Roblox's under-13 audience, so keep it as cartoon 'pet-napping' with treats and no threats. D is capped at 3 because the verb changes but movement does not.

allIdeas.title: Drag the Giant Egg
allIdeas.rides: Server-wide co-op build goal: Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K CCU / 1.1M visits to 26-28.3K CCU / 13.15M visits and sits at 96% of its 29,591 all-time high; on Sep 26 its server cap was cut from 100 to 50 because of lag (momentum sweep, ideas/research/08-momentum-2026-09-30.md, Sep 30 2026). The route passes the weekly biomes that Ride A Pet ships (Update 1 on Sep 19, Volcano on Sep 26; same source).
allIdeas.pet_core: Every player's pet is a tow animal. You clip your pet onto one of about 40 ropes tied to one colossal egg. Pull force = pet size x strength; rare pets pull harder and are visible on the rope. The egg only moves when enough pets pull the same way. Terrain gates need pet types: a river needs swimmers, a cliff needs climbers, so players swap to the pet the server needs.
allIdeas.loop: Hatch small eggs at camp -> train your pet's pull by hauling logs (gym stat) -> clip onto a rope -> the server drags the Titan Egg through 5 biome checkpoints -> each checkpoint cracks off shell chunks that drop as eggs for everyone who pulled (share = rope time x force) -> at the nest the Titan hatches a limited server pet (one copy per contributor, rarity rolled by contribution) -> a new Titan of a new species spawns at the start.
allIdeas.twist: One physics object instead of thousands of blocks, which avoids the lag that forced Build the Pyramid down to 50 players, and the pets are the engine rather than decoration. The front rope is a showoff spot for the strongest pet. A new Titan species and route ship each week, and a haunted Titan can run for Halloween.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn next to a house-sized egg with 30 pets straining on ropes. You are handed a puppy and press E on a free rope. The egg lurches forward and a chunk of shell lands at your feet: a free egg that hatches on the spot.
allIdeas.money: Pull Snack (x2 pull for 5 min, about 15R, offered when the egg stalls at a checkpoint); Front Rope Pass (lead rope plus your name carved on the Titan, about 49R); Shell Luck (better chunk roll, about 25R, offered as a checkpoint cracks); private servers for guild pulls.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget was exhausted before any search ran (tool refused with 200 of 200 used), so nothing was checked live on Roblox this run. Saved repo research: 'Build the Pyramid! hauls blocks; no egg-layer hatch pyramid found (search Sep 30 2026)'; 'Rescue Pets From the Flood and Lead the Great Migration exist; no ark-pairs build found' (saved occupancy, Sep 30 2026). A sibling batch (ideas/pets/PF.jsonl) already has Build the Egg Pyramid, Haul With Your Dog and Build the Giant Nest; a saved non-pet idea, Hook a Sea Monster Together, is a server tug on one fish. allIdeas.title: Freeze the Sea!
allIdeas.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration sims with weekly biome updates. Ride A Pet went from about 83K to 152.9K-195K CCU (about 2x in two weeks), with updates on Sep 19 and Sep 26 (Volcano) (momentum data, Sep 30 2026). The momentum data calls the field 'thin: one big winner and no named clones with numbers'.
allIdeas.pet_core: Every mount changes the terrain as it moves, and anyone can use what it leaves. A Frost Fox freezes water into an ice road. A Vine Sloth grows vine bridges between trees. A Magma Newt crusts lava so you can walk on it. A Cloud Owl leaves puff steps in the air. A Sand Crab hardens quicksand. Trails last about 90 seconds.
allIdeas.loop: Ride out from your island and lay trails to reach egg islands; eggs show as light beams. Carry the eggs home on your mount and hatch them to get new trail species, which open new terrain. Each weekly biome needs the new week's trail type to cross (a cloud sea, a lava field), and that species comes from the week's egg. Rebirth makes trails longer and wider.
allIdeas.twist: Your pet's movement writes the map for the whole server for 90 seconds, so the paths people use are made by other players. Stacking two trails, such as an ice road into a vine ramp, reaches places neither could reach alone. Strangers end up co-operating without planning it ('follow my road'). Other players cannot remove your trails, so there is no griefing.
allIdeas.first_30s: You start on a Frost Fox facing open sea. Ride forward and the water freezes under its paws. You reach a floating egg island in 20 seconds. Then you spot a stranger's vine bridge climbing a cliff you can't reach yet, ride up it, and grab the cliff egg.
allIdeas.money: Trail Extender (19R): your trail lasts 5 minutes. Paw Boost speed potion (15R). The week's Species Egg (49R): guarantees the new trail type. Gamepass for 2x trail width.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget exhausted (200/200 already used this session), so there was no live check. Local files show no terrain-writing mounts in any batch or research note. Whether Ride A Pet already has path-building mounts was NOT CHECKED.

allIdeas.title: Ride the Corn Maze
allIdeas.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration sims with weekly biome updates. Ride A Pet went from about 83K mid-Sep to 152.9K-195K on Sep 29-30, and its visits from 170.6M to 210.1M in about 2 weeks (momentum data 2026-09-30, charts and pets sweeps; the 195K figure is from ideas/research/07 snapshot, 30 Sep). IRL hook: pastel Halloween and corn mazes are this autumn's trend-guide picks (momentum irl_trends_now, 2026-09-30).
allIdeas.pet_core: Each mount breaks the maze in its own way. A bunny hops one wall, a mole tunnels under a row, a goat eats a permanent gap in the corn, an owl lifts you up for a 3-second overhead view, and a bat pings the nearest dead-end egg. The pet you ride sets your route, and every new species you hatch adds a new way through.
allIdeas.loop: The server shares one corn maze that rebuilds itself every 8 minutes. Ride in and use your pet's ability to reach pumpkin eggs at dead ends (deeper ones are rarer) and the golden egg in the center. You can carry up to 3 eggs to an exit, and carrying slows your pet. Hatch them at the farm to get a pet with a new ability. When the bell rings the maze reshuffles, and any eggs you dropped stay for the next round. The maze theme changes weekly (sunflower, hedge, candy-corn, then snow), matching Ride A Pet's weekly biome updates.
allIdeas.twist: Everyone's changes to the maze add up. Goat gaps, mole tunnels and owl flares stay open for the whole server that round, so a server with a mix of pets solves the maze faster. Players pick the pet the server is missing, which turns a solo hunt into co-play without forcing anyone into a party. I don't know of another pet game where each pet's ability is the key to a level that changes every round.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn at the maze gate on a bunny. The corn is three times your height, and a glowing egg shows over the top two rows away. You press jump, the bunny clears the wall, you grab the egg, and a banner reads 'Maze reshuffles in 7:32. Golden egg still in the center.'
allIdeas.money: Owl Flare (3 overhead scans, 19R), offered when you hit your 3rd dead end. Maze Map (full map for one round, 35R), offered at round start. Egg Satchel (+2 carry slots, 99R game pass), offered when you are carrying the maximum at an exit.

allIdeas.title: Ping the Legend Egg
allIdeas.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration with a radar egg hunt, the core of Ride A Pet. It went from about 83K to 152.9K–195K and from 170.6M to 210.1M visits in about 2 weeks (momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026).
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pet is your sensor, and each species gives only one kind of clue. Bats give distance (a ring on the map), owls give direction (a cone), dogs give hot or cold, and moles give depth. One ring is useless. Two rings meet at two points. Three pin the spot. A Legend Egg spawns every 10 minutes and normal radar can't see it.
allIdeas.loop: Ride and collect normal eggs solo. When the Legend Egg alarm sounds, ping with your pet and share the clue, which draws automatically on your party's map. The party rides to where the clues intersect and digs or grabs the egg. Everyone whose clue was used gets a hatch roll. Every new species you collect is a new clue type, which makes you more useful to parties.
allIdeas.twist: Finding the egg is co-op triangulation, and your pet's species is the information you bring. How wide your collection is becomes social value. A lone rider with one pet can only ever find half an answer.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn riding a bat and the alarm reads 'LEGEND EGG!'. You ping and a red ring draws on the map. A bot rider's owl cone appears and crosses your ring. You ride 15 seconds to the X and the egg pops out.
allIdeas.money: Echo Boost (15R): your ring is 50% thinner and more precise; offered when the alarm sounds. Clue Flare (10R): broadcast your clue to the whole server and pull strangers toward you. Species Egg (49R): a guaranteed new clue type.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: LIVE WEBSEARCH NOT RUN (budget at 200/200 on 30 Sep 2026). From saved research: Ride A Pet already has a solo radar egg hunt (momentum, 30 Sep 2026). Repo overlaps: Scout the Fog With Your Pet, Track Your Runaway Pet (a jittery location signal), and the sibling ideas Sniff Mines With Rats and Carry the Canary, where the pet is a solo sensor. No saved file has multiplayer triangulation.

allIdeas.title: Roll An Egg
allIdeas.rides: RISING: movement-verb egg hybrid (new verb: BALANCE-ROLL your egg like a circus ball) plus ride-your-pet biome routes. Race for Eggs set a new ATH of 19,682 in late Sep, 3 months after launch; +1 Wings For Eggs visits went 5.5M to 15.8M in Sep; Ride A Pet's biome cadence was Sep 19 and Sep 26 (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source ids: PF-015 (Ride the Egg) + PF-026 (Egg Roll Race) + PE-053 (Ride It to Hatch).
allIdeas.pet_core: The egg is your mount. You stand on it and roll it like a circus ball, and it hatches by distance rolled. The biomes you rolled it through decide what hatches (lava km = ember pet, snow km = frost pet). Hatched pets curl into smaller ride-eggs you can stack for the next roll.
allIdeas.loop: Pick an egg and roll it along biome routes (ramps, ice, mud, rival eggs to bump). The odometer fills and the route mix shows as colour bands on the shell. A fall cracks the shell and drops its rarity one tier. The egg hatches at the finish, and pets pay idle income at your nest. Every 10 min there is a 'Cheese Hill' downhill race: 8 eggs, and the first one into the nest hatches double.
allIdeas.twist: Hatching is a skill and a route choice, not a timer or a purchase. Distance rolled hatches the egg, the biomes you rolled through paint it, and every crack costs rarity, so careful riders on risky routes get the best pets.
allIdeas.first_30s: You hop on a giant speckled egg and W starts it rolling. You wobble but stay on down a mud ramp and the shell stripes brown. About 20s later at the pond it cracks into a Mud Pup, which curls straight into a smaller egg you can ride.

allIdeas.title: Climb For Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration sims with weekly biome updates. Ride A Pet went from about 83K mid-Sep to 152.9K-195K on Sep 29-30, and its visits rose from 170.6M to 210.1M in about 2 weeks (momentum data, Sep 30 2026, charts + pets sweeps). It also rides the movement-verb egg hybrids: Jump To Steal An Egg set a 79,949 all-time high in the last 7 days, and Race for Eggs set a new 19,682 all-time high in late Sep (momentum data, Sep 30 2026). The movement here is new: wall climbing.
allIdeas.pet_core: The pet is your climbing gear. Each species climbs a different way: a goat hops ledge to ledge, a gecko sticks to smooth walls but moves slowly, a spider drops a silk anchor that works as a checkpoint, and a snow leopard does long wall-jumps. The pets you own decide which routes up the cliff you can take.
allIdeas.loop: Mount a climber at base camp and pick a route up one shared mega-cliff. Grip stamina drains while you hang and refills on ledges. Pluck eggs from cracks into a 3-slot saddlebag; higher eggs are rarer. Bank them at a nest ledge, then hatch them at camp to get climbers with better grip. Rebirth for a grip multiplier. Each weekly update adds a new summit band on top (ice, cloud, volcano), so the mountain grows taller.
allIdeas.twist: When you fall, other players profit. Your saddlebag eggs tumble down the face with real physics, and anyone below can catch them mid-fall and keep them; the egg shows the original owner's name. Two players can rope-team (tether) so one holds the other's fall. That creates two ways to play the same wall: protect a friend, or hang under strangers and wait for eggs. None of the X-for-Eggs games in the momentum data uses vertical climbing as its movement.
allIdeas.first_30s: Tap Ride on a free goat and hop three glowing ledges. Grab a blue egg from a crack at 40m. Someone screams above you and a stranger's gold egg bounces past, so you dive and catch it: '+Legendary Egg (from Player123)'.
allIdeas.money: Chalk Bag (15R): refills grip mid-wall, offered the moment stamina turns red. Egg Net (25R): your eggs don't spill on your next fall, offered right after your first loss. Summit Lift (29R): return to your last banked ledge. Gamepass for +2 saddle slots.

allIdeas.title: Flip for Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids. Jump To Steal An Egg set its all-time high of 79,949 in the last 7 days, Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep, and +1 Wings For Eggs went from 5.5M to 15.8M visits in September (momentum data 2026-09-30, pets sweep). The same sweep found that games which change how you move beat games that only change the theme. IRL hook: the '2026 is the new 2016' bottle-flip nostalgia, with 1M+ TikTok and 37M+ Instagram posts under #2016 (momentum irl_trends_now).
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pet is the bottle. Hold to charge, release to launch it spinning, and it has to land upright on its feet. Each species flips differently: cats right themselves in the air, penguins slide after landing, frogs get a second bounce after a bad landing, and sloths spin slowly but stay in the air longer. Which eggs you can reach depends on how your pet flips.
allIdeas.loop: Flip your pet up a backyard tower of ledges, paint-can lids, fence posts and trash-can tops. Landing on an egg pad grabs that egg, and a streak of clean landings (3, 5, 10) upgrades its tier. A failed landing tumbles you down one ledge. Carry the eggs to the hatch mat, where they hatch into pets that flip differently. Rebirth into a taller themed tower (kitchen, school gym, and a haunted clocktower in October). Every 5 minutes there is a 60-second Flip-Off on the server's picnic table, and the best streak wins a mystery egg.
allIdeas.twist: You never walk. Your pet is a projectile you aim and time, and every landing either sticks or doesn't, a clear moment players can clip, just like the 2016 bottle flip. Streaks tie egg rarity to skill rather than luck. Each new species flips differently, so every hatch means learning the controls again.
allIdeas.first_30s: A cat sits on a picnic table next to a glowing egg on a paint-can lid, and a 'hold, then release' arc appears. You flip, the cat spins twice and lands on its feet, the screen flashes 'STUCK IT! x1', and the egg pops into your arms.
allIdeas.money: Aim Ghost (shows the landing arc for 10 flips, 15R), offered after 2 failed flips in a row. Sticky Paws (saves one bad landing, 10R), offered when a long streak is about to break. Streak Freeze for the Flip-Off (25R).

allIdeas.title: Link the Ant Bridge

Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K CCU / 1.1M visits to 26–28.3K CCU / 13.15M visits and is at 96% of its 29,591 all-time high after less than 4 weeks (momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026). allIdeas.pet_core: Your pets are the building material. You hatch ants from your queen: worker, carpenter, leafcutter, bullet, and rare golden or glass. You march them to the frontier, where they physically link bodies into the server's living bridge toward the next floating island. Each caste spans a different length and carries a different load. Your section wears your name tag and your ants' colours.
allIdeas.loop: Gather sugar crumbs on the current island (big crumbs need two players). Feed your queen and hatch ants, with the caste and mutation rolled at random. March a squad to the frontier and tap Link, and the bridge grows. When the server lands the bridge on the next island, everyone crosses into a new biome with new crumbs and new ant eggs. Your colony (queen level and caste collection) persists. The bridge resets each server session, and each weekly update adds a new chasm.
allIdeas.twist: The monument is alive and owned in pieces. If you leave, or recall your ants to fuse or sell them, your section goes slack and everyone standing on it sags toward the void. The server polices commitment ('who pulled out?'), and a golden-ant section is a public trophy other players walk on.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn at a cliff edge next to a half-built, wriggling bridge with a server % bar above it. Five starter ants follow you. You tap Link, they chain onto the end, and the bridge grows 2 studs with your name floating over it. A sugar cube 10 studs away prompts the loop.

Bullet Ant Egg (39R): a guaranteed strong caste; offered when a section starts to sag. The Tail rider flicks eggs off cliffs. The Feeder keeps stamina up. Only giant pets reach the far biomes, such as the deep volcano and the cloud reef, where the big eggs are.

Keep hatching until you roll your own giant pet. Then become a captain and recruit a crew. Each weekly biome can only be reached by the newest giant species.
allIdeas.twist: Your best pet is useless alone, like a ship without sailors. Owning a rare mount turns you into a host who recruits strangers, and a crew can vote to mutiny and take the reins from an AFK or reckless captain.

allIdeas.title: Let the Pets Pick
allIdeas.rides: Short-round PvP with one absurd rule-break, as a choose-a-side game. Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 all-time high within the last 7 days (momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026). Here the rule-break is that pets, not players, choose the sides.
allIdeas.pet_core: Pets pick the teams and can switch sides mid-round. Each 60-second tug-of-war round starts with a litter of pets released at the centre. Each pet runs to the player it likes most, based on the treat you hold, your emote, its species preference and your past bond, and the pet that picks you sets your side. During the tug your pet pulls with you. Players on the other rope can throw treats to lure it across, and a pet that defects adds its pull to the enemy side unless your bond holds it.
allIdeas.loop: Lobby, then pets pick you and the teams are revealed. A 60-second tug with treat-throwing follows, and the winning side splits the eggs. Pets that picked you gain loyalty, and a pet that picks you 10 times joins your collection for good. Your collection unlocks new treat types that attract rarer pets in the next pick.
allIdeas.twist: Team assignment and mid-round defection are pet decisions you can influence but never command. The lobby works like a schoolyard pick where the pets are the captains. The player nobody picks gets the Stray, a secret heavy puller, which gives the underdog a comeback.
allIdeas.first_30s: The loading screen dissolves into a ring of 16 players. A corgi sprints straight at you (the tutorial rigs it) and you're Team Corgi. You grab the rope and make timed pulls. At 20 seconds an enemy throws a sausage and your corgi wobbles, and you keep it with a pet emote.

allIdeas.title: Hush Your Pet

In 2025, the Halloween Spotlight ran Oct 23–Nov 3 with 31 games and Fish It went from 186K to 389K between Sep and Oct. Source: momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026. It is round-based hiding, not a survive-the-night countdown, and the map can be reskinned after October.
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pet is both your alarm and your giveaway. It perks its ears and whines when the Scarecrow (one player) is within 30 studs, which is your only warning. It also randomly barks, rustles the corn or chases crows, and each of those pings your position. You keep it quiet by petting it (hold E), feeding it treats or carrying it, which slows you down. Rarer pets are louder and more restless.
allIdeas.loop: A 3-minute round in a corn maze: 8 hiders with pets against 1 Scarecrow. Hiders collect candy corn while keeping their pets calm, and the Scarecrow hunts by sound pings. Caught hiders become crows who can caw near other hiders to startle their pets. Survivors split the candy pot. Candy buys eggs, which hatch rarer and louder pets to show off.
allIdeas.twist: Showing off costs stealth. Rare pets are louder, so your flex pet is a handicap you choose to carry, and players who get caught take revenge by spooking other people's pets.
allIdeas.first_30s: You drop into the maze holding a sleepy puppy. Its ears perk and it whimpers as a shadow passes the corn row. The prompt reads 'Hold E to hush'. The puppy settles just as the Scarecrow walks past 5 studs away, about 20 seconds in.
allIdeas.money: Pacifier Treat (10R): your pet stays silent for 20 seconds; offered when the Scarecrow is close. Carry Sling gamepass (49R): carry your pet without slowing down. Haunted Egg (39R): a Halloween-only mutation.

allIdeas.title: Swap Pets Midair
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb 'X for Eggs' hybrids: Jump To Steal An Egg set a 79,949 all-time high in its latest 7-day window; Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep, 3 months after launch; +1 Wings For Eggs visits went from 5.5M to 15.8M in September (12.3-14.4K CCU); Swing For Eggs holds 12.2K (rolimons) to 20.4K (market scout, Sep 27) (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). The sweep's finding is that clones which change how you move beat clones that only change the theme.
allIdeas.pet_core: Every pet is a movement verb: frog = super jump, sugar glider = glide, chameleon = tongue grapple, mole = burrow through a wall, kangaroo = double bounce, otter = water dash. You carry a 3-pet hotbar and swap pets mid-air to chain verbs. Hatching is how you unlock new ways to move.
allIdeas.loop: Egg islands float in tiers above the hub -> chain pet verbs to reach them (jump, swap to glide, swap to grapple) -> grab the egg and drop home -> the egg hatches into a new verb pet -> the new verb opens a new route and a higher tier -> each week adds a tier whose egg needs a new verb.
allIdeas.twist: In every existing X for Eggs game the player's own stat grows (+wings, +jump, +speed). Here the pets ARE the movement, so collecting gives you new moves instead of bigger numbers, like a metroidvania where the pets are the keys. Other players can bump you mid-chain, and the dropped egg falls to whoever is below.
allIdeas.first_30s: You start with a frog. Tap space and it launches you to island 1, where an egg hatches a sugar glider. Island 2 is across a visible gap: leap, swap to the glider mid-air, glide over. A banner reads 'Swap Pets Midair'.
allIdeas.money: 4th hotbar slot (about 99R); Checkpoint Feather (keep your height after a fall, about 15R, offered right after a fall); verb-egg luck boosts; glide trail cosmetics.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget exhausted (0 searches ran this run), so there was no live check. The momentum sweep (Sep 30 2026) lists the X for Eggs field as Jump To Steal An Egg, Race for Eggs, +1 Wings For Eggs, Swing For Eggs and Shuffle an Egg, and each uses ONE movement verb. allIdeas.pet_core: Every mount has two seats. The front rider steers and the back rider fires the mount's ability (fire breath melts ice, tail grapple, dig, glide). Twin Nests open only to a mount carrying 2 players, and they hatch a matching pair of twin pets, one for each rider. Twins level faster when both owners ride together.
allIdeas.loop: Ride the biome solo with a normal egg hunt -> flag 'Seat open' -> a friend or matched stranger hops on -> reach Twin Nests, which need steering and the ability at the same moment -> both riders get twin eggs -> ride together to grow the twins' bond level -> keep a daily co-ride streak -> a new biome each week with new Twin Nests.
allIdeas.twist: Ride A Pet is built around one rider. Here the pets are designed for two people, so co-play is the core mechanic, not an add-on. Twin pets are a social bond and a showoff pair, and there is no breeding.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn at the stable on a mount with an empty back seat. A stranger is auto-matched onto it. You steer while they breathe fire on an ice wall, the Twin Nest behind it cracks, and two identical glowing dragons appear, one for each of you.

allIdeas.title: Build the Nest!
allIdeas.rides: RISING: server-wide co-op build goal. Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K to 26-28.3K CCU with 13.15M visits and sits at 96% of its 29,591 ATH less than 4 weeks after its Sep 3 launch (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source ids: PF-036 (Build the Giant Nest) + PF-005 (Build the Egg Pyramid) + PR-050 (Build the Server Ark).
allIdeas.pet_core: Pets are the workforce and the payout. Each species hauls a different material in its own way: beavers drag logs, magpies fly shiny junk, moles tunnel up clay. The giant egg the server builds the nest around hatches into a chick for every contributor.
allIdeas.loop: Carry material yourself or assign a pet to a haul lane, and drop it on the nest to fill the server bar. Every 10% triggers an egg shower across the map, and those eggs hatch pets that haul more or faster. At 100% the giant egg hatches in a server cutscene. Every contributor gets a chick whose colour and mutation are weighted by the materials they personally hauled (shiny junk = metallic, wool = fluffy, lava rock = ember). Then a bigger egg lands in a new biome nest (the weekly update), with a Pumpkin Nest in late Oct. Top haulers get their name woven into the nest.
allIdeas.twist: Your haul mix is your gacha: the hatch you get depends on what you carried, not what you paid. Players specialise in materials and argue over the shiny-junk spawns, and the pets that come out become the haulers for the next, bigger egg.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn below a house-sized speckled egg with 'NEST 38%' floating above it. A glowing twig sits at your feet; you drop it in and your name ticks onto the contributor wall. About 20s later the bar hits 40% and eggs rain down on everyone.
allIdeas.money: Haul Cart (+2 carry for 15 min, 19R), offered at carry cap; Shiny Bundle (extra colour weight on your hatch share, 29R) at 80% nest; Front Row Hatch (guaranteed extra chick, 39R) at the 95% countdown; 2nd Pet Lane gamepass (99R).

allIdeas.title: Tow For Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb 'X For Eggs' hybrids, using tow-skiing, a movement none of them uses. Race for Eggs set a new 19,682 all-time high in late Sep, +1 Wings For Eggs visits went from 5.5M to 15.8M in September, and Swing For Eggs holds 12.2K–20.4K. It also borrows Ride A Pet's mounts. Source: momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026.
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pet pulls and your partner grabs. The rider steers a pet: a dolphin on water, a husky on snow, a horse on sand. The second player rides a tow rope on water skis, a sled or a board, and swings wide to snatch eggs off buoys, ramps and cliff edges. The pet's traits shape the run: dolphins jump and give the skier air time, huskies take tight turns, horses are fast on straights.
allIdeas.loop: Pair up, with a bot filling in if needed. Do a 90-second tow run down a lane full of eggs and ramps: the skier grabs and the rider steers, and both players get every egg. Hatch the eggs. Better pets open new terrain lanes. Swap roles and go again.
allIdeas.twist: The movement needs two players and one pet. You can never grab while you steer, so every egg comes from the pet's path and your partner's swing working together, and crashes are shared. That fits Roblox's co-play recommendation signal ('7-Day Intentional Co-Play Days', market scout, 27 Sep 2026).
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn holding a tow rope behind a bot's dolphin and the run starts at once. You swing left on the rope and grab a glowing egg off a buoy at 12 seconds, then hit a ramp and flip. At 30 seconds you're offered 'Drive next'.
allIdeas.money: Egg Magnet (10R): 10 seconds of wider grab radius; fires when a gold-egg buoy appears. Boost Kelp (5R): a pet speed burst before a big ramp. Longer Rope gamepass (49R): +30% swing radius.

allIdeas.pet_core: The curling stone is your penguin, and it has a brain. You push off and it belly-slides while your teammates sweep in front to straighten it. Its personality is rolled when it hatches. Greedy curves toward fish on the ice. Lazy stops early unless someone sweeps. Show-off spins and bumps other stones out. Chonk hits hard but moves slowly. Mutations such as Frost lower friction. The rule-break: the other team can toss sardines onto the ice to lure your penguin off its line.

allIdeas.loop: Fly into pitch-black cave networks and ping to see the walls and egg echoes. Between pings (there is a cooldown) you navigate from memory. Grab eggs and fly back to your roost to hatch them. Rarer bats have shorter cooldowns, wider pulses and colour-coded egg detection. Every week a new cave system opens.
allIdeas.twist: Vision itself is the pet stat. Other players' pings light the cave for you too, so strangers cluster to share echoes. The neon wireframe reveal is a ready-made clip.
allIdeas.first_30s: The screen goes black. You click and a cyan wave ripples out, showing a tunnel, a stalactite about to hit you, and a pink chime deep inside. You dodge by memory and ping again: the egg is right there. A stranger's ping lights up a side tunnel full of eggs.
allIdeas.money: Echo Burst (15R): 10 seconds of permanent vision. Tracker Chime (19R): marks the rarest egg on the floor. Glow Trail (10R): leaves a lit path back to the roost. A weekly cave egg.

allIdeas.title: Crack the Biome Wall

allIdeas.pet_core: Your pets' elements are the tools. Each week's new biome sits behind a wall with a posted weak-point recipe; for example, the Glacier Wall needs 50% fire, 30% dig and 20% heavy hits. Players aim their pets' abilities at glowing weak spots, and hits that don't match the recipe do almost nothing. The wall's meter shows what the server is missing.

When the wall breaks, everyone rushes in, and the first 10 players get Pioneer eggs. The biome stays open for the rest of the session, and the next update brings a new wall recipe.
allIdeas.twist: The server goal is a mix of elements, not a total, so whoever owns the scarce element becomes the hero. A callout board ('NEED 12 FIRE') gets strangers recruiting each other and pushes everyone to diversify their collection instead of stacking one best pet.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn at a cracked ice wall and are handed a fire salamander. The meter flashes 'FIRE 38/50'. You tap a weak spot and your pet breathes fire, the meter ticks up, and at 25 seconds a crack splits open and a Pioneer egg hint flashes.
allIdeas.money: Element Swap Egg (39R): a guaranteed pet of the missing element; offered when the meter lacks your element. Overcharge (15R): your next 10 hits count triple; offered in the last 10% of the wall. Pioneer Horn (10R): pings the server with 'NEED X' under your name.

allIdeas.title: Keep the Egg Warm
allIdeas.rides: RISING: server-wide co-op goal. Build the Pyramid! grew from ~4.3K to 26-28.3K CCU with 13.15M visits and sits at 96% of its 29,591 ATH (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source ids: HYB2-04 (Keep the Egg Warm) + MSH-086 (Raise the Server Baby, pet-finalists.jsonl).
allIdeas.pet_core: One giant egg per server is the pet everyone is raising. It stays warm only while someone carries it and hatches every 15 min. Every recent holder gets a chick weighted by their warmth share, and the species depends on the biomes the egg was carried through.
allIdeas.loop: Grab the egg. It warms while you carry it but cools fast after 30s in the same hands, so you pass it on with a throw. The server runs it around the map through biome zones. When the warmth bar hits 100%, a hatch cutscene gives every holder a chick (share = time you kept it warm), and a new, bigger egg drops. If the egg sits on the ground for 10s, it cools and cracks into a common.
allIdeas.twist: Hot potato where hogging is punished and a drop costs the whole server. The only way to get a pet is to hand the egg on, so passing is the grind and your warmth share is your gacha.
allIdeas.first_30s: A glowing egg the size of a car lands and someone throws it to you. Your screen warms orange and a 'YOU'RE HOLDING IT' meter fills. At 25s the egg starts to shiver; you toss it to a stranger and your share bar ticks up.
allIdeas.money: Heat Pack (+10s safe hold, 19R), offered at the shiver warning; Catch Mitts (auto-catch passes for 5 min, 25R) after a drop; Front Row Hatch (guaranteed extra chick, 39R) at 95%.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: No new searches this run (budget exhausted). Saved HYB2 notes (Sep 2026): one-object server push-your-luck games (e.g. the Pump the Balloon style) are crowded, and Build the Pyramid! is the only named server-goal hit. No passed-egg server game was verified this run. The title is in EXISTING_TITLES and is reused here, as this angle allows. Weak daily return (no build progression) caps A at 3.

allIdeas.title: Yoink an Egg
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids, plus the Steal-a egg economy. Steal An Egg is at 1.15M-2.03M live and gained 847,150 players over 30 days, but one tracker has it -42% week over week since its 14.27M record on Sep 19 (momentum data, Sep 30 2026). Per the momentum data, borrow only the steal-hatch economy.
allIdeas.pet_core: You ride a frog, chameleon, anteater or gecko. Its tongue is both your grappling hook (latch onto fly-posts to zip across the swamp) and your theft tool (yoink an egg off another rider's back or out of their pond base from 30 studs away). Species sets tongue range, speed and stickiness.
allIdeas.loop: Zip across the swamp by tongue-latching, yoinking eggs from lily pads and from other riders, then carry them to your pond base, where they hatch into passive-income creatures. Defend by tongue-blocking: when two tongues hit the same egg, a tug minigame starts, and a tangled pair both drop it. Upgrade tongue length and stickiness, and rebirth for a longer reach. There is no treadmill auto-play feed, because that mechanic carries delisting risk.
allIdeas.twist: Moving and stealing use the same button, and theft is ranged and can be intercepted: two tongues on one egg start a live tug-of-war instead of a base-raid timer.
allIdeas.first_30s: You click a fly-post and zip 40 studs. A player runs past carrying a glowing egg. You click them, your tongue snaps back holding the egg, they chase you, and you zip away across three posts.
allIdeas.money: Sticky Spit (15R): +50% tongue range for 5 minutes. Egg Lock (25R): your backpack can't be yoinked for 3 minutes, offered right after you're robbed. Tongue skins.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget exhausted (200/200), so there was no live check. Local: the market scout (about Sep 27) lists Swing For Eggs at 20,400 CCU / 11.3M visits, and swinging is the nearest movement. The internal PE-batch idea 'Cast Into Their Yard' already uses a line-steal the victim can cut, so the tug part overlaps. The same scout's avoid list names 'Steal a X / X for Eggs'. A Roblox frog-tongue grapple game: NOT CHECKED.

allIdeas.title: Light the Corn Maze
allIdeas.rides: Co-op and asymmetric horror in the October run-up. DOORS is +88.6% over 30 days on average players ('rising fast', rovitals). Fish It went from 186K to 389K from Sep to Oct 2025. The 2025 Halloween Spotlight ran Oct 23-Nov 3 with 31 games (momentum data, Sep 30 2026). It also rides the IRL corn-maze and pastel-Halloween trend (momentum irl_trends).
allIdeas.pet_core: The maze is pitch dark. Lost glow pets (fireflies, jack-o-lantern bats, ghost kittens) hide in the corn. Each one you find follows you and widens your light, so the pets are both your light and your score.
allIdeas.loop: Rounds are 6-minute nights with 8 players and a Scarecrow (AI in casual, a player in ranked). Find hiding glow pets: they flee from running players and come to crouching ones. Your line of pets lights the path for teammates too. The Scarecrow hunts the brightest glow on the map. You choose between tucking pets into your lantern (hidden, but you go blind) and keeping them out. Every pet that exits the gate with you before the dawn bell is yours, with glow colour showing rarity. At home, your pets light up your plot.
allIdeas.twist: The more you collect, the easier you are to see. Your collection is your light and your danger, so greed shows on screen as a glow instead of a number. A new maze theme each week, with a limited Halloween egg.
allIdeas.first_30s: The lights go out and you're in the corn with a lantern holding one firefly. You hear a faint giggle and crouch. A ghost kitten creeps over and lights up, and you can see a path. Crows scatter, and the Scarecrow's head turns toward your glow.
allIdeas.money: Dim Charm (15R): tuck your pets for 20 seconds without losing light. Pumpkin Lantern (25R): wider light radius. Keep-Pets Revive (29R): keep your pets if you're caught. Limited Halloween glow eggs.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget exhausted (200/200), so there was no live check. Local: ideas/research notes 'corn maze games exist' (unchecked). The ideas CSV has SSN-003 'Hide in the Corn Maze' (keys plus a Scarecrow stalker) and TRD-119 'Walk the Haunted Corn Maze', and the PMX batch has 'Herd the Flock Through the Night' (lanterns plus herd). All are internal ideas. Roblox pet corn-maze occupancy: NOT CHECKED. Seasonality risk after Nov 3.

allIdeas.title: Carve a Pumpkin Pet
allIdeas.rides: The October Halloween run-up, a seasonal pattern on the rising list. Fish It went from 186K to 389K between Sep and Oct 2025, and the 2025 Halloween Spotlight ran Oct 23-Nov 3 with 31 games (ideas/research/01 market scout, 2026-09-27). Getting pumpkins rides the Ride-your-pet exploration format: Ride A Pet went from about 83K to 152.9K-195K (momentum data 2026-09-30). The pumpkin patch is a ride biome and the pumpkins are the eggs. IRL hook: pastel Halloween and pumpkin season.
allIdeas.pet_core: The pet is the carving. The eye stencil sets the species family (round = cat, slanted = fox, triangle = bat, X = zombie pup). The mouth sets its ride move (grin = hop, fangs = dash, O-mouth = glide). A neat carve raises the shiny chance. How strongly your current mount can pull decides how big a pumpkin you can drag home, and bigger pumpkins guarantee a higher minimum rarity.
allIdeas.loop: Ride the pastel patch at dusk, where pumpkins with something inside glow faintly. Your pet tugs one off the vine using a hold-and-release tension bar; giant pumpkins need a strong puller or a friend's pet hitched alongside. Drag it home and carve it in 45 seconds by placing eye, nose and mouth stencils, then scoop out the guts for seeds (soft currency). Drop in a candle, the shell cracks, and out hops a pet wearing your face design, ready to ride on the next run. Each night there is a Lantern Walk: all new pets parade and players place candles to vote, and the top 3 get a permanent 'Everlit' glow.
allIdeas.twist: The player designs what comes out of the egg, so there is no blind hatch. Eyes, mouth and pumpkin variety (orange, white ghost, blue, warty) combine like a recipe book, with hidden combos to discover and share, such as star eyes plus a zigzag mouth on a white pumpkin giving a Lantern Wraith. Carving uses stencil pieces only, with no freehand drawing, so there is nothing to moderate. After Nov 3 the pumpkins switch to melons, turnips and ice blocks so the game outlives Halloween.
allIdeas.first_30s: A starter pumpkin sits on your porch table. You drag two round eyes and a grin onto it (10s) and drop in the candle (3s). It cracks, and a round-eyed cat with your jack-o'-lantern grin pops out. You hop on and the gate to the glowing patch swings open.
allIdeas.money: Stencil Packs (rare eye and mouth pieces, 19-49R), offered in the carve screen when you tap a locked piece. Giant Haul (drag one giant pumpkin this run, 35R), offered when a giant is too heavy. Lantern Spotlight (front of the parade plus 5 extra candles, 15R), offered before the nightly walk.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: My own web searches did not run (session budget used up, 200/200, on my first query, 2026-09-30). From repo research, not re-checked: 'Pumpkin carving games likely exist (unchecked)' (raw/TRD.jsonl, Sep 2026) and 'Pumpkin Patch Night Shift and Giant Pumpkin exist in the main list as different loops; carving contest unchecked' (pets folder note, 30 Sep 2026). So that core idea is not new in this repo. Whether any Roblox game hatches a pet from a carving was not checked.

allIdeas.title: Unwrap a Golden Egg
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids, with swimming the rapids as the movement. Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep and Jump To Steal An Egg set one of 79,949 in the last 7 days (momentum data 2026-09-30). IRL hook: Netflix's 'Wonka's The Golden Ticket' premiered Sep 23 2026 with a $3M prize and its finale is Sep 30, and Ferrero and Netflix are relaunching Wonka candy this autumn (momentum irl_trends_now). A Ferrero digital golden-ticket unwrap promo is expected in Nov (factcheck/result_8.jsonl, Sep 2026). The game uses generic candy only, with no Wonka names or lookalikes.
allIdeas.pet_core: Your mount is a river swimmer, and how it swims is the skill. Otters dive under rapids, ducks skim over whirlpools, and hippos plow through other riders and swamp them. The foil-wrapped candy bars floating downstream are the eggs, and unwrapping one reveals the pet inside.
allIdeas.loop: Jump your pet into a looping chocolate river. Dodge rapids and whirlpools while scooping up floating foil bars; your pet's back sets how many you can carry. A hippo's wake can knock bars off other riders, and dropped bars float on to whoever is behind. Dock to bank your bars, then peel the foil (a satisfying tear sound) to reveal the pet. Better swimmers can reach the fast lanes, where rarer wrappers float. About every 15 minutes, one bar in the server hides a Golden Egg.
allIdeas.twist: Whoever finds the Golden Egg picks the river's next flavour for the whole server (caramel falls, mint rapids or sour-candy whitewater), which decides which pet family floats by for the next 15 minutes. That makes it a world-changing moment everyone watches for, not a private drop. The river is also a shared economy: anything you drop becomes loot for someone downstream. Own a Candy Lab (in EXISTING_TITLES) already uses 5 golden tickets per server-hour and a Factory Gate chase, so this idea avoids gate runs on purpose.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn on a candy dock and your starter duck waddles over. You jump on, splash in, scoop up 3 foil bars in 15 seconds, dock, and peel one: a caramel-striped bunny pops out. A banner says 'Golden Egg not found yet: 11:42 left.'
allIdeas.money: Foil Glint (golden wrappers shimmer for 60s, 25R), offered when the Golden Egg timer drops under 3 minutes. Big Saddlebag (+5 carry, 99R game pass), offered when you hit the carry limit mid-river. Double Peel Luck (15 minutes, 29R).
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: My own web searches did not run (session budget used up, 200/200, on my first query, 2026-09-30). From repo research, not re-checked: 'No Roblox golden-ticket unwrap game found; only a Golden Ticket Chocolate Factory UGC shoulder accessory (Dec 2023, 102 favorites), rolimons' (factcheck/result_8.jsonl, Sep 2026), and 'no golden-ticket chase game found' (repo note, 9/27). Swim and surf games where pets hatch already exist: Surf And Rescue, Surf and Plunge, Kayak and Surf (pets folder note, roblox.com 30 Sep 2026). Own a Candy Lab (golden tickets plus freeze-dry) is in EXISTING_TITLES. Timing risk: the show's hype peaks this week, so a game built in up to a month will launch after the peak.

allIdeas.title: Fill the Cauldron
allIdeas.rides: Server-wide co-op build goal. Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K to 26-28.3K CCU and 13.15M visits, and sits at 96% of its 29,591 all-time high less than 4 weeks after its Sep 3 launch. Its server cap was cut from 100 to 50 on Sep 26 because of lag (momentum data 2026-09-30). The pets sweep marks this as an open slot that no pet game has filled yet, so it is unproven for pets. IRL hook: the Halloween 2026 run-up, in a pastel witchy style.
allIdeas.pet_core: Only pets can carry ingredients, and each species carries one kind. Bats bring moon-dust from rooftops, frogs haul swamp water, spiders bring cobweb bales, and black cats sneak candy from porches. Pets get stronger carriers the more they haul, and the payoff lands on your pets.
allIdeas.loop: Each server (sized for 30-50 players) has two giant cauldrons, Sweet Witch and Spooky Witch, and you join a side. Choose which pet to send and haul its ingredient; carry capacity grows with each trip. The recipe board fills up (for example 400 cobwebs, 300 swamp water and 1 golden bat). The first cauldron to boil over rains its brew on every pet in the server (Sweet gives a pastel candy look, Spooky a glowing ghost look), and each of its contributors gets a brew-egg. The losing side gets a consolation egg. A new recipe starts every 12 minutes, and a different witch each week changes the ingredient list.
allIdeas.twist: It is a co-op build split into two rival halves, so the server races against itself. Players switch sides to decide which look every pet in the server gets next. Proportions matter too: overfilling one ingredient spoils the brew into a rare Cursed variant, so dumping the wrong ingredient becomes a gamble instead of plain griefing.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn between two bubbling cauldrons whose bars read 62% and 58%. Your starter frog hops into the swamp and fills a bucket, and you throw it in. The bar jumps, a server-wide message says 'Spooky is 3 buckets from boiling!', and ten seconds later green glitter rains on your frog.
allIdeas.money: Double Haul (15 minutes of double carry, 25R), offered when your side is within 10% of boiling. Recipe Peek (see which ingredient spoils next, 15R). Side Switch (skip the cooldown on changing sides, 10R).
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: My own web searches did not run (session budget used up, 200/200, on my first query, 2026-09-30). From repo research, not re-checked: 'Build the Pyramid! occupies the co-op monument lane; few server-goal games' (repo notes, Sep 2026). Internal pet co-op ideas already include Build the Egg Pyramid, Build the Giant Nest, Build the Server Ark and Spin the Server Web (pets/PF.jsonl, pets/PR.jsonl). EXISTING_TITLES includes Dip a Pet (a paint-dip reveal) and Weather Your Pet (mutations from server weather), which are near the brew payoff. A two-cauldron pet race was not checked.

allIdeas.title: Spin for Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids: Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep and Jump To Steal An Egg one of 79,949 in the last 7 days (momentum data 2026-09-30). It borrows only one piece of Steal An Egg's economy, clashes that knock eggs loose. Steal An Egg is #1 at 1.15-2.03M and gained 847,150 players over 30 days per rovitals (momentum data). IRL hook: Beyblade is on the list of toys kids want now (momentum irl_trends_now).
allIdeas.pet_core: Pets that curl up (armadillo, hedgehog, pangolin, pill bug, hermit crab, snail) are the spinning tops. Each shell sets weight, stamina and grip, and you steer your own spinning pet. Hatched eggs give new curling species, so your collection is your lineup of tops.
allIdeas.loop: Rounds of up to 8 players in a candy-bowl stadium last 60-90 seconds. Pull the ripcord, where a timing bar sets launch power. Steer your spinning pet over eggs, which stick to its shell like a snowball picking things up. Hitting another spinner knocks a chunk of its eggs loose. When your spin runs out you keep whatever is stuck to you. Hatch the eggs for new tops and climb to higher stadium tiers.
allIdeas.twist: Collisions steal eggs instead of doing damage, so this is an egg-grab sport, not pet fighting. That matters because pet fighting is falling: Grow a Chicken Fighter went from 242.7K to 13.8K, down 94% (momentum data 2026-09-30). Carried eggs make you heavier and slower, so the leader becomes the obvious target and greed is the risk.
allIdeas.first_30s: Your armadillo curls up in your hand and a big ripcord prompt appears. You pull on green, it zips into the bowl, and eggs pop onto its shell with a click. You clip another top and 3 eggs fly over to you.
allIdeas.money: Ripcord Upgrade (launch power tiers, 25-49R), offered on the launch screen after a weak launch. Shell Wax (more grip for one round, 10R), offered before a ranked bowl. Re-Spin (relaunch once when your spin dies while holding 10+ eggs, 15R).

From repo research, not re-checked: Ball VS Ball has 41.2M visits and about 14.7K CCU and owns physics roll-fights (ideas/research/01 market scout, 2026-09-27; Rolimons, Sep 2026). The internal pet idea Hamster Ball Brawl (pets/PF.jsonl) is a bump-off arena, and the internal non-pet ideas Spin a Battle Top, Launch a Spinning Top and Spin the Top Arena all cover Beyblade with occupancy marked unchecked. allIdeas.title: Sprout Nine Tails
allIdeas.rides: +1 hybrids with a second loop. +1 Loot To Forge has 46.3-62K now with an 80,380 48-hour peak around Sep 28 at 7 weeks old, and +1 Wings For Eggs went from 5.5M to 15.8M visits in September (momentum data 2026-09-30). A bare +1 twist no longer brings players (+1 DMG FPS has 1.6-8.4K despite a 94.9% rating), so here the +1 is a layer on top of riding to reach eggs. The look borrows the anime-familiar style of Slayers 2, which has 129-215K with a 232K peak on Sep 27 (momentum data). The theme is a Halloween spirit fox.
allIdeas.pet_core: Your fox mount grows +1 tail every few seconds of riding, and each tail is one extra mid-air jump, so your tail count decides how high you can reach. Other spirit species put the +1 on a different body part, each tied to a way of moving: a bat gets +1 wing (longer glide), a spider +1 leg (longer wall-climb), and a hydra +1 head (+1 egg carried).
allIdeas.loop: Ride while your pet grows parts at +1 per second. Use the tails, wings or legs to reach floating shrine islands where spirit eggs sit (higher ones are rarer). Falls and bumps make you shed some of the parts you grew. Bank eggs at the shrine and hatch new species that grow different parts. At 9 tails the fox Ascends, which is the rebirth: parts reset, the fox gets a new element colour, and the +1 gets faster.
allIdeas.twist: The +1 grows a body part everyone can see that adds a new way to move, not a number on a stat bar, and falling costs you the parts you grew. A nine-tailed fox is a flex anyone can read from across the map. Because each hatched species grows a different part, the collection is a set of movement styles rather than a multiplier.
allIdeas.first_30s: You land on a fox cub with one tail. A counter ticks '+1 TAIL... +1 TAIL', and each new tail swishes in with a chime. At 4 tails you quadruple-jump onto a floating shrine with a glowing egg, and you can see the next shrine sitting about 9 tails higher.
allIdeas.money: Tail Guard (keep your parts through the next 3 falls, 15R), offered right after a fall. Double Sprout (15 minutes, 29R), offered near an Ascension. Spirit Egg Reroll (19R).
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: My own web searches did not run (session budget used up, 200/200, on my first query, 2026-09-30). The momentum data (2026-09-30) names +1 Wings For Eggs (+1 flight plus egg steal) as the nearest existing game, and +1 Dino Evolution sits at 38% of its all-time high, marked 'falling fast'. A +1 game where the pet grows body parts was not checked.

allIdeas.title: Float Up on Pets
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids plus +1 hybrids: +1 Wings For Eggs visits went from 5.5M to 15.8M in September at 12.3-14.4K CCU, with an Ancient Egypt and trading update on Sep 25; Swing For Eggs holds 12.2-20.4K (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026).
allIdeas.pet_core: Hatched pets are floaty creatures (pufferfish, jellyfish, balloon dog, blimp whale) tied to your back, and each one adds lift. Your altitude is literally your collection, shown as a bouquet of pets above your head. Rarer pets lift more and glow.
allIdeas.loop: Float up -> grab eggs on the sky islands your altitude band reaches -> hatch -> tie the new pet on -> reach a higher band -> storms and birds knock pets loose, and you have 20s to catch them before they drift back to your ranch (others who touch a drifting pet get a coin tip, not the pet) -> rebirth turns the bouquet into permanent lift.
allIdeas.twist: In Wings For Eggs the player's own wing stat grows. Here the pets are the lift and are visible to everyone, so a rare bouquet is showoff and movement at once. Losing a pet mid-air is a dramatic, clippable moment without real loss.
allIdeas.first_30s: One balloon-dog pet on your back lifts you 10 studs. An egg sits on a cloud; you grab it and it hatches a pufferfish, and you rise. A bird pecks the dog loose and you chase it through the sky.
allIdeas.money: Anchor Knot (pets cannot be knocked loose for 10 min, about 19R, offered as a storm arrives); Helium Boost (about 15R); rare floaty eggs; bouquet ribbon cosmetics.

Saved: a sibling idea, Pop a Pet Balloon (ideas/pets/PE.jsonl), has pets drifting in balloons that you pop, which is a different mechanic; balloon-pump games are crowded (Dont POP the Balloon and others, saved note 9/30). allIdeas.title: Catch the Falling Kittens
allIdeas.rides: Rescue-and-clean creature tycoons. Surf And Rescue is #2 on rovitals trending (score 507.2, +132.7% in 24h, Sep 2026), but no CCU was found (momentum data, LOW confidence). The same data shows rescue and care games small and steady (Save Animals went from 25.5K to about 2.5K).
allIdeas.pet_core: Every rescue target is an animal stuck up high (a tree, a roof, a burning barn, a cliff nest), and each one panics in its own way. Every animal you catch becomes your pet after a clean-up. A fluffy big-dog pet can lie down as a cushion, so a pet is also a rescue tool.
allIdeas.loop: An alarm marks a stuck animal. Two to four players grab the corners of a physics rescue blanket, and everyone has to move together. The animal jumps when scared: a kitten wobbles, a goat leaps sideways, a baby dragon flaps and drifts. A catch counts as a shared rescue; a miss sends the animal into a bush and it runs, so you chase it. Brush and clean it at your shelter (a short ASMR step). Keep it, or rehome it to NPC families for cash and reputation. Bigger rescues unlock over time: a fire-station ladder, cliffs, storm events.
allIdeas.twist: The rescue is physics co-op with strangers holding one blanket, so the skill is coordination, not a click. Solo players catch with a cushion pet instead, which makes pet choice matter.
allIdeas.first_30s: 'KITTEN ON THE ROOF!' Three players run to a sheet and you grab a corner. The kitten meows and leaps, the sheet sags left, everyone shuffles, and it bounces in. A rainbow tabby is yours.
allIdeas.money: Big Blanket (15R): wider catch area. Calm Treat (10R): the animal waits 10 seconds longer before jumping. Cushion Dog (99R): a Robux pet that lets you catch solo.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: WebSearch budget exhausted (200/200); my query for Surf And Rescue CCU was blocked, so its live count is still 'not found'. Local: the PMX batch has 'Rescue Pets From the Flood' (carry-rescue, internal idea). A Roblox blanket-catch rescue game: NOT CHECKED.

allIdeas.title: Ride the Giant Turtle
allIdeas.rides: RISING: ride-your-pet exploration with weekly biomes (Ride A Pet 152.9-195K on Sep 29-30) plus a server-wide co-op goal (Build the Pyramid! 26-28.3K, 96% of its ATH); momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026. Source id: PF-017 (Live on the Tortoise).
allIdeas.pet_core: The server's shared mount is the map: 30-50 players live on the shell of one giant turtle that walks through biomes. At each stop, every player's small pets hop off to forage what the biome offers and bring back eggs.
allIdeas.loop: Build a small plot on the shell while the turtle walks its loop. Each biome it passes (jungle, desert, volcano) opens a 3-min foraging stop, where you send pets off to forage and hatch biome eggs. Feeding the turtle is the server's shared goal: a hungry turtle sits down and the next biome never arrives. At milestones the turtle grows a size and the shell gains a new ring of plots. Each weekly update adds a new biome to the route.
allIdeas.twist: You don't ride to the biomes; the biome comes to everyone at once. The whole server rides one pet, so feeding it is the co-op goal, foraging stops are the rush, and the weekly biome is literally the turtle's next destination.
allIdeas.first_30s: You spawn on a grassy island that suddenly lurches: it is a turtle's back. A desert slides into view and a 'STOP: 3:00' banner pops. Your bunny hops off and comes back with a sandy egg that hatches before the turtle walks on.
allIdeas.money: Fruit Crate (+5% toward the feed goal, 19R) at 90% hunger; Forage Boost (pets bring back 2 items, 25R) at the stop banner; Shell Plot expansion (49R) at build cap; Front-seat Plot (99R).

allIdeas.title: Fling Friends For Eggs
allIdeas.rides: Movement-verb 'X For Eggs' hybrids, with a movement no rival uses: another player's pet launches you. Jump To Steal An Egg set its 79,949 all-time high in its latest 7 days, and Swing For Eggs holds 12.2K–20.4K. Source: momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026.
allIdeas.pet_core: Your pet is a launcher, and it can only launch other people, never you. A frog tongue slings, a kangaroo kicks, an elephant's trunk tosses, an octopus springs, and each gives a different arc. A friend or stranger climbs on, you aim, and they fly to eggs on sky islands. Every egg they grab is split between the launcher and the flier.
allIdeas.loop: Queue at a launch pad and take turns launching and flying. Grab eggs in mid-air and on sky islands. Hatch launcher pets with longer or smarter arcs, which reach higher islands. Launch chains are possible: land on another player's launcher and get sent further.
allIdeas.twist: Your movement is performed by someone else's pet, so every egg is a trust fall. Launch chains across strangers' pets turn the whole server into a relay network.
allIdeas.first_30s: Within 5 seconds a bot's kangaroo kicks you skyward. You grab an egg on a floating cloud at 12 seconds and float back down. The pad flips to 'your turn to launch', with a stranger already waiting.
allIdeas.money: Trajectory Line (25R): shows the arc before you launch. Safety Bubble (10R): no splash-down when a launch misses; offered after your first miss. Party Pad (99R): launch 4 players at once.
allIdeas.occupancy_seen: LIVE WEBSEARCH NOT RUN (budget at 200/200 on 30 Sep 2026). From saved research: Fling Things and People, at 58K (front-page snapshot, 30 Sep 2026), already owns flinging other players as a toy. Swing For Eggs has 20.4K / 11.3M visits (market scout, 27 Sep 2026), and the market scout lists 'X for Eggs' under avoid. The overlap is real, which is why O is 3.

allIdeas.title: Grab a Pet Bed
allIdeas.rides: Short-round PvP with one absurd rule-break (Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 all-time high in the last 7 days; momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026). The rule-break is that you never sit; your pet does.
allIdeas.pet_core: It's musical chairs where the pet is the game piece and you are the coach. While music plays, the pets roam and dance inside the circle. When it stops, you whistle your pet to a bed, and whether it goes depends on its obedience and whatever is distracting it. Other owners can squeak toys to pull your pet off course. Each round has one bed fewer, and pet species matter: cats are fast but ignore whistles, while labs are loyal but get distracted by toys.
