trend_check.reasoning:
(1) TREND: PASS, with caveats. The idea borrows from the two pet formats in the momentum data that are still rising. The first is ride-your-pet with weekly biomes (HIGH confidence): Ride A Pet went from about 83K to 152-195K in two weeks, visits went from 170.6M to 210.1M, and updates came Sep 19 and Sep 26. The second is movement-verb 'X for Eggs' games (MEDIUM confidence): Jump To Steal An Egg set an all-time high of 79,949 in the last 7 days, and Race for Eggs set one of 19,682 in late Sep. The idea's claims in 'rides' match the data. It avoids both formats the user asked about. Pure +1 runners are falling: Keyboard Escape is down 93-98% from its 3.69-7.26M peak on Jul 18. 99 Nights is falling too: it sits at 104-260K against a 14.15M all-time high and is -11% week over week. The idea avoids Grow-a-X timers and pet fighting as well. Three caveats. (a) The 'Cheese Hill' 8-egg race puts a pet race at the centre, and pure pet racing is falling in the same data: Dog Race went from 17,569 to 553 (-97%), and Horse Race has 923 players. Race for Eggs is the only racing exception, and it is an egg-grab hybrid. (b) The winning X-for-Eggs games share a grab/steal-egg, then base, then idle-income economy. This idea drops the grab/steal part, so it gets only part of that pull. (c) The confidence is MEDIUM. Steal An Egg, the leader, is flat to -42% week over week on one tracker, and the Hunt event (Sep 17-28) inflated September peaks, so expect a dip this week. One small naming risk: in Roblox slang 'Roll' often means an RNG roll (as in Sol's RNG). 'Ride An Egg' echoes 'Ride A Pet' and is harder to misread.

(2) A 9-YEAR-OLD: The first 30 seconds work (get on the egg, hold W, go down the mud ramp, the shell turns brown, it hatches into a Mud Pup), and hatching by distance feels like Pokemon GO. But the full rule set is heavy: biome mix sets the species, each crack drops rarity one tier, pets curl back into ride-eggs, you stack eggs, and there is idle income on top. Stacking is never explained. A balance mechanic that wobbles and then punishes falls will frustrate kids on mobile thumbsticks, which is most of the audience.

(3) BUILD: borderline. I count about 10 systems:
1. A balance-roll controller: a physics sphere with the player on top, plus wobble and fall detection.
2. Tracking distance per biome zone.
3. A hatch table driven by the biome mix, plus dynamic colour bands on the shell.
4. Crack and rarity-tier drops.
5. Hatching, inventory and DataStore saving.
6. Pets turning into ride-eggs, and stacking.
7. The nest and idle income.
8. PvP egg bumping, which needs multiplayer physics and network ownership.
9. The Cheese Hill race: a queue every 10 min, 8 racers, finish detection and the x2 hatch.
10. Four in-context purchase prompts.
The builder also needs 4-5 routes with ramps, ice, mud, pond and lava. Items 1, 8 and 9 are the risky ones, because Roblox rolling-ball physics with a character on top is notoriously janky. One scripter can do this in 4 weeks only if the ball is faked: a scripted sphere whose angular velocity follows the player's input, with the character welded on top and a wobble animation. Stacking and the timed race should wait until after launch.

(4) MONETIZATION: good. Shell Patch (19R, offered right at the crack), Golden Shell (49R) and Odometer x2 for 15 min (29R) are consumables sold at the moment something goes wrong. Biome Pass (35R) is a one-time skip, which is fine as a secondary product. There is a small contradiction with the pitch: 'hatching is a skill, not a purchase', but two of the products buy your way out of the skill check. That is acceptable, but the pitch should say so honestly.

Verdict: WEAK, not FAIL. The trend holds up, but the build is borderline because of the physics-heavy multiplayer core, and the race mode leans on the falling pet-racing format.

verified.title: Climb For Eggs
verified.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration sims with weekly biome updates. Ride A Pet went from about 83K mid-Sep to 152.9K-195K on Sep 29-30, and its visits rose from 170.6M to 210.1M in about 2 weeks (momentum data, Sep 30 2026, charts + pets sweeps). It also rides the movement-verb egg hybrids: Jump To Steal An Egg set a 79,949 all-time high in the last 7 days, and Race for Eggs set a new 19,682 all-time high in late Sep (momentum data, Sep 30 2026). The movement here is new: wall climbing.
verified.pet_core: The pet is your climbing gear. Each species climbs a different way: a goat hops ledge to ledge, a gecko sticks to smooth walls but moves slowly, a spider drops a silk anchor that works as a checkpoint, and a snow leopard does long wall-jumps. The pets you own decide which routes up the cliff you can take.
verified.loop: Mount a climber at base camp and pick a route up one shared mega-cliff. Grip stamina drains while you hang and refills on ledges. Pluck eggs from cracks into a 3-slot saddlebag; higher eggs are rarer. Bank them at a nest ledge, then hatch them at camp to get climbers with better grip. Rebirth for a grip multiplier. Each weekly update adds a new summit band on top (ice, cloud, volcano), so the mountain grows taller.
verified.twist: When you fall, other players profit. Your saddlebag eggs tumble down the face with real physics, and anyone below can catch them mid-fall and keep them; the egg shows the original owner's name. Two players can rope-team (tether) so one holds the other's fall. That creates two ways to play the same wall: protect a friend, or hang under strangers and wait for eggs. None of the X-for-Eggs games in the momentum data uses vertical climbing as its movement.
verified.first_30s: Tap Ride on a free goat and hop three glowing ledges. Grab a blue egg from a crack at 40m. Someone screams above you and a stranger's gold egg bounces past, so you dive and catch it: '+Legendary Egg (from Player123)'.
verified.money: Chalk Bag (15R): refills grip mid-wall, offered the moment stamina turns red. Egg Net (25R): your eggs don't spill on your next fall, offered right after your first loss. Summit Lift (29R): return to your last banked ledge. Gamepass for +2 saddle slots.

The flaw is that the first-30-seconds hook ("a stranger's gold egg bounces past") only happens if another player falls above you at that moment. In a new or empty server it won't happen, so the first 30 seconds become plain ledge hopping. Controls are also a risk: hanging on a wall while riding a pet is harder on a touchscreen than running or jumping.

(3) BUILD (1 scripter + 1 builder, 1 month or less): BORDERLINE. I count about 13 systems:
1. Mount/ride
2. Four separate climb movements (goat ledge-hop, gecko wall-stick, spider anchor checkpoint, leopard wall-jump)
3. Grip stamina
4. Egg spawns in cracks, rarer with height
5. 3-slot saddlebag
6. Banking at nest ledges
7. Hatching, pet inventory and equip
8. Rebirth multiplier
9. Routes locked by species
10. Eggs that spill with real physics and can be caught mid-fall, tagged with the owner's name
11. Rope-team tether that holds a partner's fall
12. Summit Lift teleport and the dev products
13. Saving player data

The builder also needs one mega-cliff with separate routes for each species plus base camp. Three items are hard for one scripter:
- Gecko wall-sticking needs custom raycast climbing that turns the rider to face the wall, plus camera handling on the wall.
- Physics eggs moving between players need server control of who caught what, or exploiters will grab every egg.
- A rope tether between two player characters is a well-known source of jitter and "flinging" on Roblox.
Each alone fits in a month, but all three plus four movement types does not fit safely. Borderline, not clearly impossible, so WEAK rather than FAIL.

(4) MONEY: PASS. Chalk Bag (15R, offered when stamina turns red), Egg Net (25R, offered after your first loss) and Summit Lift (29R) are real consumable painkillers, each offered at the moment it hurts. It is missing the biggest earner in egg games: a luck or auto-hatch potion.

verified.rides: Movement-verb egg hybrids. verified.pet_core: Your pet is the bottle. Hold to charge, release to launch it spinning, and it has to land upright on its feet. Each species flips differently: cats right themselves in the air, penguins slide after landing, frogs get a second bounce after a bad landing, and sloths spin slowly but stay in the air longer. Which eggs you can reach depends on how your pet flips.
verified.loop: Flip your pet up a backyard tower of ledges, paint-can lids, fence posts and trash-can tops. Landing on an egg pad grabs that egg, and a streak of clean landings (3, 5, 10) upgrades its tier. A failed landing tumbles you down one ledge. Carry the eggs to the hatch mat, where they hatch into pets that flip differently. Rebirth into a taller themed tower (kitchen, school gym, and a haunted clocktower in October). Every 5 minutes there is a 60-second Flip-Off on the server's picnic table, and the best streak wins a mystery egg.
verified.twist: You never walk. Your pet is a projectile you aim and time, and every landing either sticks or doesn't, a clear moment players can clip, just like the 2016 bottle flip. Streaks tie egg rarity to skill rather than luck. Each new species flips differently, so every hatch means learning the controls again.
verified.first_30s: A cat sits on a picnic table next to a glowing egg on a paint-can lid, and a 'hold, then release' arc appears. You flip, the cat spins twice and lands on its feet, the screen flashes 'STUCK IT! x1', and the egg pops into your arms.
verified.money: Aim Ghost (shows the landing arc for 10 flips, 15R), offered after 2 failed flips in a row. Sticky Paws (saves one bad landing, 10R), offered when a long streak is about to break. Streak Freeze for the Flip-Off (25R).

The support is Jump To Steal An Egg's all-time high in the last 7 days, Race for Eggs' late-Sep all-time high and +1 Wings' tripled visits. Three things weaken it:
- The parent game is cooling. Steal An Egg is -42% week over week on one tracker since its Sep 19 record.
- Swing For Eggs sits at 38% of its peak (rolimons).
- The Hunt event (Sep 17-28) inflated mid-Sep peaks.

It is not a falling format, so this is no FAIL. But it has two honest gaps:
- The IRL hook is not trending right now. The momentum file calls '2026 is the new 2016' 'steady all year, not specific to this week'. That nostalgia also belongs to teens and adults: a 9-year-old in 2026 was born around 2017 and never lived the 2016 bottle flip. So the hook adds little for the Roblox audience and does not answer the user's 'trending right now' ask.
- 'Flip' is close to 'jump'. Jump To Steal An Egg already holds that verb at 79.9K. The file's advice was an unused movement (glide, dig, surf, climb, grapple).

The idea also drops the format's economic engine. The format is defined as 'grab eggs, then hatch for idle income', but this idea has no base, no income per second, no currency and no stated rebirth cost. It turns into a skill tower-climber that uses 'X for Eggs' naming. That makes the claim that it rides the format weaker.

(2) 9-YEAR-OLD TEST: pass. The title 'Flip for Eggs' fits the 'X for Eggs' naming kids already know. The first 30 seconds are clear: hold, release, 'STUCK IT! x1', and the egg lands in your arms. Minor risk: in Roblox trading slang, 'flip' also means reselling.

(3) BUILD in 1 month with 1 scripter and 1 builder: borderline. I count about 12 systems:
1. A custom pet-as-projectile character controller that replaces walking
2. Upright-landing detection
3. 4 per-species flight and landing behaviours (self-right, slide, second bounce, slow spin with hang time)
4. An aim arc preview for mobile and PC
5. The 'tumble down one ledge' fail state
6. Egg pads, grabbing and carrying
7. Streak tiers
8. Hatch mat, inventory and equip
9. Rebirth
10. The Flip-Off server event every 5 minutes, with a leaderboard
11. Three contextual dev products
12. DataStore and UI

The builder has 4 vertical maps (backyard, kitchen, gym, haunted clocktower), and ledges must be tuned to each species' arc, since which eggs you can reach depends on how your pet flips. Real physics flips replicated across a server are a genuine risk to fit in a month. The October clocktower also has to ship around Oct 30, right against a Halloween Spotlight window (2025's ran Oct 23-Nov 3; 2026 dates are not announced). It is doable only if the flip is faked with a scripted arc and the scope is cut, so it is borderline, not a clear fail.

(4) MONEY: pass. All three products are consumable painkillers offered at the moment of pain:
- Aim Ghost (15R), offered after 2 failed flips
- Sticky Paws (10R), offered when a streak is about to break
- Streak Freeze (25R)

One catch: tying egg rarity to skill removes the genre's biggest money lever, which is luck boosts and auto-hatch. Also, Aim Ghost in the Flip-Off reads as pay-to-win.
trend_check.fix:
1. Restore the format's economy. Each hatched pet sits on your base and earns coins per second. Coins buy Flip Power levels (a +1-style layer: a higher max charge reaches higher ledges). Rebirth costs coins and raises the multiplier. Without this, it is a skill-based obby with an egg skin.

2. Fake the physics. Use a deterministic scripted arc (tween or CFrame) driven by a charge meter that has a 'stick zone'. Where you release decides stuck or fail. Each species changes only the zone width, hang time and a post-landing tween (slide, bounce). One controller with 4 parameter sets, not 4 physics sims.

3. Cut launch scope to 1 backyard tower, 4 species, 3 egg tiers and the Flip-Off. Ship the kitchen and haunted clocktower as the first two weekly updates. That copies the Sep 19 and Sep 26 cadence that took Ride A Pet from about 83K to 152-195K.

4. Put luck back into monetization. Streaks upgrade the egg tier, while a Lucky Egg potion (consumable) and an x2 hatch-luck pass add a random layer on top of skill. Make Aim Ghost unusable in the Flip-Off so it does not read as pay-to-win.

5. Drop the '2016 bottle flip' pitch as the trend claim. It is steady and aimed at adults, not rising. Sell the idea on the clip moment ('STUCK IT' mid-air spins) and the movement-verb egg wave.

6. Before committing, run one search for 'Flip For Eggs' / 'Flip a Pet' on Roblox. Occupancy is unchecked because the search budget ran out. Also consider a less jump-adjacent verb (grapple or glide) if Jump To Steal An Egg keeps climbing.

verified.title: Link the Ant Bridge
verified.rides: Server-wide co-op build goal. Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K CCU / 1.1M visits to 26–28.3K CCU / 13.15M visits and is at 96% of its 29,591 all-time high after less than 4 weeks (momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026). The same sweep calls pet teams in server-wide goals 'an open slot, not a proven pet trend'.
verified.pet_core: Your pets are the building material. You hatch ants from your queen: worker, carpenter, leafcutter, bullet, and rare golden or glass. You march them to the frontier, where they physically link bodies into the server's living bridge toward the next floating island. Each caste spans a different length and carries a different load. Your section wears your name tag and your ants' colours.
verified.loop: Gather sugar crumbs on the current island (big crumbs need two players). Feed your queen and hatch ants, with the caste and mutation rolled at random. March a squad to the frontier and tap Link, and the bridge grows. When the server lands the bridge on the next island, everyone crosses into a new biome with new crumbs and new ant eggs. Your colony (queen level and caste collection) persists. The bridge resets each server session, and each weekly update adds a new chasm.
verified.twist: The monument is alive and owned in pieces. If you leave, or recall your ants to fuse or sell them, your section goes slack and everyone standing on it sags toward the void. The server polices commitment ('who pulled out?'), and a golden-ant section is a public trophy other players walk on.
verified.first_30s: You spawn at a cliff edge next to a half-built, wriggling bridge with a server % bar above it. Five starter ants follow you. You tap Link, they chain onto the end, and the bridge grows 2 studs with your name floating over it. A sugar cube 10 studs away prompts the loop.
verified.money: Royal Jelly (25R): 2x hatch speed for 10 minutes; offered at the frontier when you run out of ants. Bullet Ant Egg (39R): a guaranteed strong caste; offered when a section starts to sag. Server Swarm (99R): every player in the server gets 10 ants and the buyer is announced; offered at 90% bridge completion.

verified.title: Crew a Giant Pet
verified.rides: Ride-your-pet exploration with weekly biome drops. Ride A Pet went from about 83K in mid-Sep to 152.9K–195K on Sep 29–30, visits went from 170.6M to 210.1M in about 2 weeks, and it shipped updates on Sep 19 and Sep 26 (Volcano). Source: momentum sweep and front-page snapshot, 30 Sep 2026.
verified.pet_core: A mount's size sets its crew size. Small pets carry 1 rider. Giant pets (a rhino beetle with 3 seats, a mammoth with 4, a sky whale with 6) only move well when their stations are filled. The Driver steers. The Spotter on the head holds the egg radar. The Tail rider flicks eggs off cliffs. The Feeder keeps stamina up. Only giant pets reach the far biomes, such as the deep volcano and the cloud reef, where the big eggs are.
verified.loop: Ride your small pet solo and hunt eggs with the radar. When you hear a Captain's horn, hop onto a stranger's giant pet as crew. Reach a far biome, grab eggs, and split them by station. Keep hatching until you roll your own giant pet. Then become a captain and recruit a crew. Each weekly biome can only be reached by the newest giant species.
verified.twist: Your best pet is useless alone, like a ship without sailors. Owning a rare mount turns you into a host who recruits strangers, and a crew can vote to mutiny and take the reins from an AFK or reckless captain.
verified.first_30s: You spawn next to a giant beetle captained by a bot that honks 'Need a Spotter!'. Press E to board and you're handed the radar. It pings after 10 seconds, and at second 25 the tail rider flicks the egg into your arms, where it starts incubating on your saddle.
verified.money: Captain's Horn (15R): a server-wide recruit ping with your pet's portrait; offered when seats are empty. Extra Saddle (99R): +2 seats on a giant pet; offered when your crew is full and players are queuing. Stamina Treat (10R): offered mid-ride when the mount is slowing far from home.

- a flying controller for the sky whale
- 3 store products

For the builder, that means small pets, 3 rigged and animated giant mounts with seat stations, and 3 biomes. The live-ops rule that each weekly biome is reached only by the newest giant species means one builder must ship a new rigged multi-seat mount every week, which isn't sustainable. There is also a hidden problem with empty servers. A new game launches at low player counts, and giant pets 'only move well when stations are filled', so it needs bot fill-ins. That adds another system on top of the count above. It is borderline rather than a clear fail, because a version with one giant pet, 3 seats and 2 biomes fits in a month.

(4) MONEY: PASS. Stamina Treat (10R) is a true consumable painkiller, offered mid-ride when the mount is slowing far from home. Captain's Horn (15R) is a consumable offered when seats are empty. Extra Saddle (99R) is a permanent upgrade, which is fine as a one-off. One conflict: if players can buy stamina, the Feeder seat does nothing, so one of the two has to go.

Overall: the trend and money checks pass. The title is borderline, and the build is over budget until it's cut down, so the verdict is WEAK, not FAIL.
trend_check.fix: 1) Rename it to 'Board a Giant Pet', which is the Verb-a-Noun pattern and matches the press-E-to-board opening. The alt title 'Ride It Together' has no pet noun. 2) Cut the launch version to one giant pet, a rhino beetle with 3 seats: Driver, Spotter with the radar, and Tail who flicks eggs. Launch with a starter biome and one far biome, the volcano. 3) Drop the Feeder seat and let the Stamina Treat handle stamina. Drop mutiny for launch and replace it with an automatic hand-over when the captain is AFK for 60 seconds. Hold the sky whale and flying until week 3 or later. 4) Fill empty seats with simple bots so a lone player can still move a giant pet at 50% speed, which also fixes the empty-server problem at launch. Run the tutorial bot captain on a fixed path, not real pathfinding AI. 5) Change the weekly plan: each weekly update is a new biome and egg that existing giant pets can reach with one new station tool. Release a new giant species only every 3-4 weeks. 6) Keep the solo small-pet radar hunt fun on its own, because Ride A Pet's solo loop is what's proven. Make crewing a speed and loot bonus, not something the game can't be played without.

verified.title: Let the Pets Pick
verified.rides: Short-round PvP with one absurd rule-break, as a choose-a-side game. Illegal Soccer set its 81,522 all-time high within the last 7 days (momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026). Here the rule-break is that pets, not players, choose the sides.
verified.pet_core: Pets pick the teams and can switch sides mid-round. Each 60-second tug-of-war round starts with a litter of pets released at the centre. Each pet runs to the player it likes most, based on the treat you hold, your emote, its species preference and your past bond, and the pet that picks you sets your side. During the tug your pet pulls with you. Players on the other rope can throw treats to lure it across, and a pet that defects adds its pull to the enemy side unless your bond holds it.
verified.loop: Lobby, then pets pick you and the teams are revealed. A 60-second tug with treat-throwing follows, and the winning side splits the eggs. Pets that picked you gain loyalty, and a pet that picks you 10 times joins your collection for good. Your collection unlocks new treat types that attract rarer pets in the next pick.
verified.twist: Team assignment and mid-round defection are pet decisions you can influence but never command. The lobby works like a schoolyard pick where the pets are the captains. The player nobody picks gets the Stray, a secret heavy puller, which gives the underdog a comeback.
verified.first_30s: The loading screen dissolves into a ring of 16 players. A corgi sprints straight at you (the tutorial rigs it) and you're Team Corgi. You grab the rope and make timed pulls. At 20 seconds an enemy throws a sausage and your corgi wobbles, and you keep it with a pet emote.
verified.money: Squeaky Toy (15R): extra attraction during the team pick; sold in the lobby. Loyalty Collar (25R): your pet can't defect this round; offered when an enemy treat lands near your pet. Treat Cannon gamepass (99R): throw treats twice as far.

Still, the user asked for "trending right now", and this is the weakest trend link available.

(2) CAN A 9-YEAR-OLD FOLLOW IT: borderline. "Let the Pets Pick" doesn't say pick what; "Pets Pick Your Team" would. The first 30 seconds read well (corgi runs to you, grab the rope, pull, a sausage lures it, you keep it). But the pick uses four hidden inputs (treat, emote, species preference, bond), which a child can't see. So to a new player, not being picked feels random, and being the kid nobody picks is a bad feeling on day one. The Stray only helps one player.

(3) BUILD, 1 scripter + 1 builder in a month: borderline. I count about 12 systems:
1. Round/lobby manager for a 16-player ring
2. Pet-pick AI with attraction scoring and pathing
3. Tug physics with timed pulls
4. Treat projectiles
5. Mid-round defection logic
6. Emote-to-keep
7. Saved bond data per pet per player
8. Collection
9. Treat unlock tree
10. Egg split, plus hatching
11. The Stray
12. Rigged tutorial and 3 purchases

Each one is simple, so it can be built, but a month is tight. The hidden problems are structural:
- 16-player rounds need full servers at launch, so bot fill becomes another system.
- Pets choosing freely produce lopsided teams.
- Defection snowballs toward whichever team is winning.
- Collected pets do nothing except unlock treats, which is a weak collection hook for a pet game.
- 10 picks from the same random pet is a slow first unlock.

(4) MONEY: partial. The Loyalty Collar (25R), offered when an enemy treat lands near your pet, is a real painkiller sold at the right moment. But it turns off the core twist, defection, for the whole round. The Squeaky Toy is a vitamin, not a painkiller, and it effectively lets you pay to pick your team. The Treat Cannon (99R) is pay-to-win in PvP against other kids.

Net: nothing clearly fails, but (1), (2) and (3) are all borderline, so the verdict is WEAK.

Cut the treat unlock tree and the egg split. Lower collection to 3 picks, and let a collected pet come with you as a guaranteed loyal puller. 4) Change the Loyalty Collar to a one-shot "Hold!" that blocks a single lure (about 15R), so defection still happens. Change the Squeaky Toy into a cosmetic trail or emote so the pick can't be bought. Keep the Treat Cannon out of ranked play, or make it cosmetic only. 5) Before committing, re-run the live occupancy search for Roblox tug-of-war and team-pick games. verified.title: Hush Your Pet
verified.rides: Co-op and asymmetric horror in the October run-up, plus the pastel-Halloween and corn-maze real-world trend. DOORS is +88.6% over 30 days on average players and Forsaken is at 82–88K. In 2025, the Halloween Spotlight ran Oct 23–Nov 3 with 31 games and Fish It went from 186K to 389K between Sep and Oct. Source: momentum sweep, 30 Sep 2026. It is round-based hiding, not a survive-the-night countdown, and the map can be reskinned after October.
verified.pet_core: Your pet is both your alarm and your giveaway. It perks its ears and whines when the Scarecrow (one player) is within 30 studs, which is your only warning. It also randomly barks, rustles the corn or chases crows, and each of those pings your position. You keep it quiet by petting it (hold E), feeding it treats or carrying it, which slows you down. Rarer pets are louder and more restless.
verified.loop: A 3-minute round in a corn maze: 8 hiders with pets against 1 Scarecrow. Hiders collect candy corn while keeping their pets calm, and the Scarecrow hunts by sound pings. Caught hiders become crows who can caw near other hiders to startle their pets. Survivors split the candy pot. Candy buys eggs, which hatch rarer and louder pets to show off.
verified.twist: Showing off costs stealth. Rare pets are louder, so your flex pet is a handicap you choose to carry, and players who get caught take revenge by spooking other people's pets.
verified.first_30s: You drop into the maze holding a sleepy puppy. Its ears perk and it whimpers as a shadow passes the corn row. The prompt reads 'Hold E to hush'. The puppy settles just as the Scarecrow walks past 5 studs away, about 20 seconds in.
verified.money: Pacifier Treat (10R): your pet stays silent for 20 seconds; offered when the Scarecrow is close. Carry Sling gamepass (49R): carry your pet without slowing down. Haunted Egg (39R): a Halloween-only mutation.
verified.occupancy_seen: LIVE WEBSEARCH NOT RUN (budget at 200/200 on 30 Sep 2026). From saved research: Forsaken 82–88K and DOORS 56K (front-page snapshot, 30 Sep 2026). Repo overlaps: the existing titles Guide a Blind Pet Through the Dark, Don't Walk Alone and Sneak Up on It, and the sibling ideas Survive the House Cat, Keep Watching the Cat and Escape the Hamster Cage (where sound is the information). None uses your own pet as both the warning and the giveaway.

Remove the pet and the loop is 8 hiders vs 1 player-hunter in a 3-minute round: collect things, get caught, then harass the survivors. That is the hide-and-seek / asymmetric-killer round, one of the most occupied formats on Roblox. Forsaken runs the 1-vs-many round at 82-88K CCU today (frontpage snapshot, 30 Sep 2026), far above the 5K CCU line for TAKEN. The 'monster finds you by sound' part is a crowded lane of its own: there is a licensed A Quiet Place: Deadzone plus several games along the lines of 'It Hears You' (factcheck SSN-030). Hiding as a pet already exists too: Play Cats: Hide and Seek has 19M+ visits. The idea is essentially the repo's own SSN-003 corn-maze Scarecrow, which was already flagged as TAKEN if the Forsaken numbers held, and now they do. The pet mechanic (it warns you, gives you away, and rarer pets are louder) is a real twist that nobody seems to occupy. But it changes how the round plays, not what kind of game it is, and it was not checked live.

On the user's ask ('something that's trending right now'), this idea fits poorly. The momentum report rates October horror MEDIUM and describes it as 'an inference from the seasonal pattern, not a live trend'. DOORS is -7.7% week over week, and 2026 Spotlight dates are not announced. The rising pet formats with actual measurements are Ride A Pet (about 83K to 152-195K in two weeks), the 'X for Eggs' games that change how you move, and Build the Pyramid!-style server-wide goals. Round-based asymmetric play also needs full lobbies (a real player as the Scarecrow every round) and earns LOW per the council's party-round notes. Being skeptical: the loop is TAKEN, so FAIL.
occupancy.fix: Drop the player-Scarecrow round, which is Forsaken's lane, and keep only the pet mechanic (it alerts you, it gives you away, and flex pets are louder) as a limited-time layer on a measured riser. The best option is a late-October 'Haunted Corn Maze' biome inside a ride-your-pet exploration game in the Ride A Pet style. Your mount sniffs out Haunted Eggs, and an AI Scarecrow roams the biome. Your pet's ears and whines are your warning, and its barks draw the Scarecrow. Hush the pet or ride it quietly to grab the egg. Rare, loud pets find eggs faster but get caught more. Keep the Pacifier Treat and Haunted Egg; drop the Carry Sling gamepass because riding replaces carrying. It works solo or co-op and needs no full lobby. If you keep it standalone, make the Scarecrow AI (1-4 player co-op, with an optional player-Scarecrow mode) and let hatched pets persist so it isn't a cosmetics-only party round. Before building, run the live searches: 'roblox hide and seek pet', 'roblox pet barks horror', and CCU/visits for A Quiet Place: Deadzone and It Hears You.

trend_check.reasoning:
(1) TREND: borderline, and it does not really answer what the user asked for. The user wants something trending right now because +1 runners and 99 Nights have fallen off. This idea rides "co-op/asymmetric horror in the October run-up," and the momentum sweep itself calls that "an inference from the seasonal pattern, not a live trend" (MEDIUM confidence).

(2) KID CLARITY: mostly fine. "Hush Your Pet" follows the 2-4 word verb-your-noun pattern, but "hush" does not say "hide from a monster." The alt title "Hide With Your Pet" is clearer for a 9-year-old. The first-30-seconds beat (a scarecrow walks past 5 studs away at about 20 seconds) cannot be guaranteed when the Scarecrow is a real player. It needs a scripted first round with an NPC Scarecrow.

(3) BUILD: over-scoped for one scripter plus one builder in 4 weeks. I count about 11 systems:
1. Lobby and round manager with 8v1 role assignment and a minimum player count.
2. The Scarecrow's kit: catching players and a sound-ping reveal UI.

4. The 30-stud proximity warning, with ear and whine animations.

Keep the "your pet is both your alarm and your giveaway" mechanic, but put it inside a format that is rising right now, and cut the multiplayer requirement.

verified.title: Steal the Flock
verified.rides: RISING: movement-verb steal hybrid (new verb: HERD live loot with your dog instead of carrying it) on the Steal-a base economy. Jump To Steal An Egg set its 79,949 ATH in the last 7 days (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). IRL hook: a sheepdog puppy training video at 4.7M views / 319K likes (momentum IRL sweep, Sep 30 2026). Source ids: PF-002 (Whistle Away the Flock) + PR-003 (Escape the Sheepdog).
verified.pet_core: You own two kinds of pet. Sheepdogs are your herding style: a collie's stare freezes sheep, a corgi nips heels, a kelpie runs across backs. Sheep are what the dogs herd; they have wool tiers and golden-fleece mutations and pay idle income in your pen.
verified.loop: Hatch or buy lambs; they graze in your pen and grow wool for income. verified.pet_core: Wild herd animals are platforms first, then mounts, then ranch stock. Every mount you own was earned by staying on its back inside the herd. Your best mounts let you leap further into the rarer middle of the next stampede.
verified.loop: A herd of ~150 animals, shared by the whole server, thunders around the map on a fixed loop. Leap from back to back (jump plus grab timing) and stay on one animal for 20-30s to tame it; rarer animals buck harder. Tamed animals go to your ranch and earn coins. (1) TREND: PASS, with medium confidence. The idea rides the movement-verb "X for Eggs" wave, which the Sep 30 sweep lists as a rising pet format (MEDIUM confidence). It also follows the sweep's advice for Ride A Pet, the one HIGH-confidence rising pet format. It avoids both formats the user said have fallen off. Pure +1 Escape runners are down 93-98% from peak, and the idea's twist explicitly drops the +stat growth. 99 Nights is down more than 98% from peak. So it fits "something trending right now." Four risks:
- The Hunt event (Sep 17-28) inflated mid-September peaks, and Jump To Steal An Egg's 79.9K high has no current CCU behind it.
- Swing For Eggs is at 38% of its peak on rolimons, so single-verb entries can fade within weeks.

- The parent game, Steal An Egg, may be cresting. A game built in one month launches in early November, which may be late in the wave.

(2) CAN A 9-YEAR-OLD FOLLOW IT: borderline. The first 30 seconds are clear: frog jump, hatch a glider, glide over a visible gap. But the title "Swap Pets Midair" names a control input, not a goal. It drops the word "Eggs", which is what makes kids recognize the format, and none of the alternative titles have it either. Swapping pets mid-air is a timing skill that is hard on mobile. "Tap space" doesn't exist on a phone, and aiming the chameleon's tongue grapple on a touchscreen is hard for kids.

(3) BUILD (one scripter plus one builder in 1 month or less): borderline. Systems I counted:
- a custom movement controller with 6 verbs (super jump, glide, tongue grapple with rope and aim, burrow with collision toggling, double bounce, water dash)
- a mid-air hotbar swap state machine that handles every verb-to-verb transition
- pet equip visuals
- egg carry, drop on hit, falling-egg ownership transfer
- a networked mid-air PvP bump that has to feel fair despite lag
- hatching, pet inventory and DataStore saves
- level design for metroidvania gating, where every island has to be tested against every verb combination so players can't skip it
- server-side checks against movement exploits, since flying straight to the top tier is the obvious cheat
- shop, gamepass and dev products, plus hotbar, hatch and index UI
That is about 10 systems, and the core one (chained movement feel) needs a lot of tuning. It fits in a month only if launch is cut to 3-4 verbs. At the full scope described, B=4 is generous and B=3 is closer.

Design problem that affects monetization: if each tier needs a specific verb and eggs are random, bad luck blocks progress, and the luck boost becomes paying to progress. If the needed verb is guaranteed, the luck boost has nothing to boost. The loop also has no currency or idle layer (the X for Eggs games pay idle income from hatched pets). That means the content runs out once a player has all the verbs for a tier, and nothing is left to grind between weekly updates.

(4) MONETIZATION: partial pass. The Checkpoint Feather is a good painkiller: a consumable for about 15R, offered right after a fall. Luck boosts are consumable but conflict with the gating problem above. The 4th hotbar slot is a one-time gamepass, and the trails are cosmetic. The bump mechanic creates an obvious second pain point (losing your egg) that nothing currently sells relief for.

Overall WEAK: the trend is sound, but the build scope and the title are both borderline.

4. Guarantee each tier's key verb from that tier's egg (first hatch is always the new verb). Point the luck boost at shiny, giant or mutated variants of the pets, so paying never becomes the way to progress.
5. Add an idle currency layer, like the other X for Eggs games: pets at your home base earn coins that buy hatch speed and cosmetics. This gives players something to grind between weekly tiers.

verified.title: Rob the Egg Train
verified.rides: The egg-steal-and-hatch economy (Steal An Egg #1 at 1.15-2.03M, +847,150 over 30 days, but flat to -42% week over week since its 14.27M record on Sep 19) used only through a hybrid, with ride-your-pet (Ride A Pet about 83K to 152.9-195K) (momentum sweep, Sep 30 2026). The train is the setting, not a parent format; the train survival game Dead Rails is listed as cooling (front-page snapshot, Sep 30 2026).
verified.pet_core: Your mount is the getaway ride. The Egg Express crosses the map every 8 minutes; you gallop alongside, leap onto a car, grab an egg and leap back onto your pet. Mount speed and jump decide how long you can keep pace and how many cars you reach. The loot hatches into better mounts.
verified.loop: Wait at the station -> the train departs -> ride alongside -> leap onto a car and grab an egg (carrying slows you) -> dodge NPC guards who shove you off -> jump back onto your mount -> ride home to hatch -> faster mounts reach the rarer front cars on the next run (a Golden car every hour).
verified.twist: You steal without robbing players: the target is a server-wide NPC train, so nobody loses progress while offline. Players still compete for the same cars live and can knock each other off. Every run is a timed server event, so the whole lobby gallops together.
verified.first_30s: A whistle blows and a train of glowing egg cars rolls past. You are on a horse at full gallop. Press E to leap onto a car, grab an egg and leap back. Twenty seconds later it hatches a cheetah mount.
verified.money: Lasso Hook (grab an egg from range, about 15R, offered when you miss a car); Guard Bribe (guards ignore you for one run, about 19R); Golden Car Ticket; mount eggs. For Halloween, a ghost-train event.

occupancy.reasoning:
Take away the train skin and the core loop is: use a movement ability to grab eggs from a shared source, bring them home, hatch them, and get better movement. That is the rising "X for Eggs" wave, and the saved notes list at least four small-to-mid games already doing it: Jump To Steal An Egg (79.9K all-time high), Race for Eggs (19.7K), Swing For Eggs (12-20K) and +1 Wings For Eggs (12-14K). A mount-gallop-and-leap is just the fifth movement verb in that list.

The other half of the idea, riding your pet and carrying eggs home to hatch, is Ride A Pet's loop. Ride A Pet is at 153-195K and ships weekly updates, so it could add an "egg train" event in a single update. The egg economy underneath it belongs to Steal An Egg (1.15-2.03M, with 8+ clones).

The only parts I could not find in the saved notes are the moving, timed NPC train you board car by car and the jump from mount to train and back. But that board-a-moving-train-and-loot-it mechanic is iconic in Jailbreak (from memory, unverified), so it is not a new mechanic either, just new to pets.

Why not TAKEN: no single occupant with 50M+ visits was shown running this exact combination (mount, moving NPC train, egg grab, hatch). Steal An Egg steals from player bases and Ride A Pet hunts eggs with a radar. Neither has a timed train target. Several small-to-mid occupants share the core loop, so this is CROWDED, which scores WEAK.

Main caveat: 0 live searches ran because the budget was exhausted. A direct occupant, such as a "Steal Eggs From the Train" game or a train event inside Steal An Egg or Ride A Pet, cannot be ruled out, so treat this as a floor of CROWDED, not a ceiling. On the user's question: the idea correctly avoids +1 runners and 99 Nights, which have both fallen off (-93-98% and -98% from their peaks). It rides the two pet formats that are rising, but so do several live games.
occupancy.fix:
1) Before building, run these checks with a fresh search budget: roblox "egg train"; roblox "rob the train" pet; roblox "steal" eggs train; site:roblox.com/games train eggs; rolimons "Egg Express". Also check whether Steal An Egg or Ride A Pet has run a train or convoy event. If any has 5K+ CCU, drop the idea.
2) Make the train the whole game, not a skin on a movement verb. Examples: cars that decouple, a car-by-car climb to the Golden engine, bridges and tunnels that knock riders off, and a co-op move where one player's mount holds pace while a partner boards. The pitch should be "board a moving loot convoy" and not "gallop for eggs."
3) Avoid the "___ For Eggs" or "Steal A ___" naming, since theme-only reskins failed (Steal A Brainrot Egg 4.2K, Steal A Lucky Egg 6.7K). "Rob the Egg Train" is fine but needs a title-collision check.
4) Ship fast and plan the Halloween ghost train as the first event (late Oct). Ride A Pet's weekly update pace means an incumbent could copy a train event within about 2 weeks.

trend_check.reasoning:
To the user's question first: yes, both have fallen off. +1 Speed Keyboard Escape is down 93-98% from its Jul 18 peak (now 128-267K), and 99 Nights is down more than 98% from its 14.15M all-time high (now 104-260K, 7-day average -11% week over week). This idea avoids both.

(1) TREND: PASS, but the pitch cites the wrong parent. It names Steal An Egg as what it rides, and that game is plateauing (flat to -42% week over week since the Sep 19 record, 8+ clones). Structurally, though, the idea is "Ride To Steal An Egg": you grab eggs by moving in a new way, with no base raid. That puts it in the rising movement-verb egg hybrids. Jump To Steal An Egg set its all-time high within the last 7 days, and Race for Eggs set a new all-time high 3 months after launch. The ride-your-pet verb is the one HIGH-confidence rising pet format (Ride A Pet roughly doubled in two weeks). There is a gap, though. Ride A Pet grows on weekly biome updates (Sep 19, Volcano Sep 26), and this pitch has no update plan like that, so it borrows only the verb. The train theme leans toward Dead Rails, which is cooling. So it is not a falling format, but it is not the cleanest rising one either.

(2) KID CLARITY: the title passes. A 9-year-old knows what "Rob the Egg Train" means, and robbery themes are normal on Roblox. The first 30 seconds are only borderline. The pitch shows the train arriving right away, but the train runs every 8 minutes, so a new player who joins mid-cycle may wait up to 8 minutes at a station. Also, "hatches twenty seconds later" conflicts with the loop, which makes you ride home before you can hatch.

(3) BUILD, 1 scripter + 1 builder, ≤1 month: BORDERLINE. That is why this is WEAK and not PASS. I count about 10 systems:
- rideable mounts with speed and jump stats
- a moving train on a server-side track
- jumping from a mount onto a moving car
- grabbing and carrying an egg, which slows you
- NPC guards that patrol and shove players on moving cars
- players knocking each other off
- hatching, inventory and equipping mounts
- car rarity tiers, the hourly Golden car and a server event timer
- a home or hatch base
- saving data, the shop and developer products

Three of these are the hardest networking work in Roblox: players standing on server-moved platforms, jumping from a client-simulated mount onto a server-moved train, and NPCs on moving platforms. These are the core loop, so they cannot be cut. For the builder, a long track, train cars, stations and several animated four-legged mounts is a heavy month.

(4) MONETIZATION: PASS. Lasso Hook (about 15R, offered right after you miss a car) and Guard Bribe (about 19R, lasts one run) are true consumable painkillers, sold at the moment of frustration. Golden Car Ticket is a consumable pass into the event. Mount eggs round it out.

Result: (1) passes, (3) is borderline and (2) has a fixable wait-time hole, so the verdict is WEAK.
trend_check.fix:
1. Cite the rising neighbors (Jump To Steal An Egg, Race for Eggs, Ride A Pet) as the parent, not Steal An Egg. Pitch it as "Ride To Steal An Egg".

2. Remove the wait. Run 2-3 trains on a loop so one passes about every 60-90 seconds. Keep the hourly Golden car as the timed server event. Spawn new players already galloping next to a tutorial train, and let them hatch on the spot during their first run.

3. Cut the risk out of the build. Move the train with CFrame on a fixed loop, and keep standing players on it with a short platform-stick script (no physics trains). Make the "leap" a short, assisted jump that snaps you to the car. Weld guards to fixed patrol lines on each car, with no pathfinding. Leave player-vs-player knockoff for v1.1. Give every mount one shared four-legged rig and set of animations, and make mounts differ only in their mesh or skin and their stats.

4. Borrow Ride A Pet's update rhythm. Every week, add a new line of track through a new biome (Volcano Line, Snow Line), each with its own egg. Make the Halloween ghost train the late-October event.

5. Add one more painkiller at the moment you get knocked off: Quick Remount / Catch-Up Gallop, about 10R.
